Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

Key Features
• Pure & Immersive Experience
• Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards. Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines? Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

items.description:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

Tap the right boxes, guide your ants, clear the blocks, and uncover beautiful pixel art. Your colony is waiting!

items.short_description: "Colorever: relax with sparkling gems and beautiful coloring art. Every gem belongs somewhere. Tap a gem and watch the whole cluster glide home, one…
items.description:
"Colorever: relax with sparkling gems and beautiful coloring art.

Every gem belongs somewhere. Tap a gem and watch the whole cluster glide home, one by one, until a bright gem art picture is complete. Easy for everyone, fun for all ages. No timers. No fail screens. No game over. Just you, the gems, and a calm little puzzle you can always solve.

WHY PLAYERS STAY

See the whole picture from the start. Nothing is hidden, nothing is guesswork. You always know where every gem is going, so the pleasure comes from planning the route, not from hunting for a secret. Colorever is a puzzle funny game you can play with your shoulders down.

HOW TO PLAY

Tap a gem, move a cluster. Tap one gem and every connected gem of the same color is picked up together, then flies to its matching space one gem at a time.
Read the board. Each space on the board already shows the color of the gem it is waiting for. Match gem to space and it locks into place with a satisfying click.
Use the tray. The tray holds gems you are not ready to place yet. Park a few, open up the board, then bring them back in when the space is free.
Finish the picture. Place the last gem and the full gem art scene lights up, ready for your gallery.

A GROWING GEM GALLERY

Hundreds of pixel art pictures to complete, from animals and food to flowers, cities and cozy little scenes, with fresh sets added regularly. Every picture you finish is saved to your gallery, so your collection of gems and gem art keeps growing as you play.

FEATURES

Relaxing by design. No countdown, no losing streak, no pressure. Play one puzzle on a coffee break or twenty in a row.
Always solvable. Every level has a solution, so getting stuck is temporary, never fatal.
Gentle learning curve. The first gem puzzles teach themselves. Later boards are wide, layered and genuinely worth thinking about.
Handy helpers. Add an extra tray space, undo a move, take a hint, or let a smart tap tidy up the easy gems for you.
Made to feel good. Crisp gems, glowing diamonds, soft sound and light haptics on every placement.
Play offline, anywhere. No connection needed. Pause mid puzzle and pick it up hours later, exactly where you left it.
For everyone. Simple enough for a first ever puzzle game, deep enough for players who like to plan three moves ahead.

FOR PLAYERS WHO LIKE

Relaxing puzzle games. Gem art and coloring pixel pictures. Gem, jewel and diamond puzzles. Calm brain games and quiet logic. Satisfying, oddly soothing placement games.

Take a breath. Tap a gem. Let the gem art shine."

items.description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

items.description:
SMASH EVERY CASTLE. RULE EVERY ARENA.
Castle Busters is fast, loud, and unfair in the best way. Every brick breaks. Every shot counts. Draft 8 units, load your keep, and turn your rival's castle into a pile of rubble before they do it to you first. No grinding waves of bots. No 20-minute matches. Just real-time 1v1 PvP where one good angle wins the war.

DESTROY THE WALLS, NOT THE CLOCK
Matches are quick. Decisions are not. Pick your shot, read the enemy line, and fire. Every wall, tower and turret is destructible, so the map is never the same twice. Collapse a floor under an archer. Carve your own path, literally.

DRAFT YOUR SQUAD
Wrecker, Napalmer, Bomber, Scout, Fairy, Crow... Pick any 8. Each unit changes how you play, what angles you attack, and how you defend. Some builds are patient. Some are chaos. None of them are wrong if they win.

FORTIFY THE KEEP
Your castle is your army's home, shield, and weapon. Reinforce the walls that matter. Leave decoys. Bait your rival into breaking through somewhere they shouldn't. Defense isn't passive here, it's a trap.

THE FORGE
Upgrade your units. Strengthen your keep. Unlock new arenas with new hazards, new obstacles, new ways to break things. The deeper you go, the meaner the meta gets.

CLIMB THE LADDER
Climb your away towards Clash Colosseum. Arena by arena. Seasonal leaderboards. Rank matches against players who want your crown as badly as you want theirs. Only one castle stays standing. Sharpen your aim. Stack your squad. Crack their keep. The arena is open. Go break something.

Jigsaw Drop: Solitaire Puzzle — A Fresh Take on Relaxing Picture Puzzles

This is a puzzle game designed for moments of focus and relaxation. Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or enjoying a quiet break, the smooth flow and satisfying interactions make it easy to settle in and keep playing.

HOW TO PLAY
- Move pieces to complete parts of a picture
- Connect matching fragments to reveal the full image
- Clear completed sections to make room for new pieces
- Watch fresh tiles fall into place as the puzzle evolves
- Think ahead and manage your space to keep progressing

The mechanics are simple at first, but each level introduces new layouts that encourage thoughtful play and gentle strategy.

GAME HIGHLIGHTS
- A New Kind of Jigsaw Experience
The falling system adds movement and rhythm to traditional puzzles, creating a more dynamic way to play.
- Smooth and Satisfying Gameplay
Every connection feels rewarding, with clean visuals and responsive controls that make each action enjoyable.
- Beautiful Picture Collections
Explore a wide range of scenes, from nature and everyday objects to artistic compositions, all designed to be visually pleasing.
- Play at Your Own Pace
No timers, no pressure—just a relaxed environment where you can enjoy solving puzzles in your own time.
- Designed for Focus and Relaxation
A great choice for players who enjoy quiet, thoughtful gameplay that helps clear the mind.

Each level offers a fresh layout and a new way to approach the board. As pieces fall and the puzzle shifts, you’ll find yourself naturally adjusting your strategy and discovering new patterns.

Whether you play for a few minutes or a longer session, the experience remains smooth, rewarding, and easy to return to.

Download Jigsaw Drop: Solitaire Puzzle and enjoy a relaxing puzzle journey where every piece falls into place.

versions.changelog:
[New Content]
1. New "Fire Crystal Age" Expansion:
Winter will one day be lit by fire! Once the Furnace reaches Fire Crystal Lv. 1, your City will officially enter the "Fire Crystal Age".
In this new age, survivors are gradually overcoming the threats of bitter cold and death. Complete Survivor Profiles give every survivor in the City a unique identity.
As life becomes more stable, survivors begin to hope for better housing, food, healthcare, work, and entertainment. The old Mailbox will be transformed into the "Wish Station", where survivors can share their hopes for a better future.
As the Furnace Level increases and prerequisite Wishes are completed, more Wishes will become available. Completing Wishes rewards Chiefs with "Wish Sigils", which can be exchanged in the "Wish Shop" for exclusive materials used to construct future entertainment Buildings.
At the same time, the Chief Order feature will enter a new phase alongside city development. Some old Chief Orders will be removed after entering the Fire Crystal Age, and new Chief Orders such as "Crunch Time", "Advanced Training", and "Dawn Alliance Commendation" will be added to provide new support for resource production, soldier training, and city development.
2. New "Endless Trials" Gameplay: Wulfgar, the barbarian chieftain known as the "Windhowler" from the far north, is about to appear on the tundra! After the event begins, eligible Chiefs can head to the Wilderness after 00:30 (UTC) each day to challenge the "Windhowler". Each Chief can launch up to 30 solo attacks per day; rallies cannot be initiated. The system will calculate daily rankings based on each Chief's highest single-instance damage that day. The event includes daily participation rewards, daily leaderboard rewards, and achievement rewards to help Chiefs keep pushing the limits of the trial.
3. New Value Events: 
(1) Introducing "Hero Ascension Training". Chiefs can earn event points by ascending the corresponding heroes during the event. Reach the specified point targets to collect rewards for each tier. Unlock "Battle Stars" to earn even greater rewards.
(2) Introducing "Exclusive Gear Forge". Chiefs can earn event points by developing the Exclusive Gear of the corresponding heroes during the event. Reach the specified point targets to collect rewards for each tier. Unlock "Champion Forge" to earn even greater rewards. 

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Overview Feature Optimization: A new "Daily" tab will be added to the in-game Overview panel on the left. Chiefs can use this tab to view the progress, remaining attempts, and claimable status of daily content such as the Arena, Treks, The Labyrinth, Crystal Laboratory, Hero Recruit, Alliance Contribution, Lighthouse, Online Rewards, Expert Skills, Alliance Activity Triumph, and more, making it easier to plan daily tasks efficiently.
2. Chief Gear and Charm Level Cap Increase: In States where the state progress has already unlocked Gen 6 heroes, Legendary T6 Chief Gear (3-Star) will officially become available. Once the State progress unlocks Gen 8 heroes, Lv. 17 and Lv. 18 Chief Charms will be added, with 9 sub-stages per level. Chiefs can further improve their Gear and Charm quality to obtain even greater Power.
3. Hero Gear Optimization: Once Gear Mastery reaches Lv. 4 or above, Mastery upgrades will change from full-level upgrades to sub-stage upgrades, while the total cost of Mastery Forging will remain unchanged. When performing Mastery Forging, Chiefs can use the progress bar to easily track their progress toward the next level.
4. Chat Feature Optimization: The maximum number of members in a chat group will be increased to 200, allowing more Chiefs to join the same group for communication.

Block Crush is a classic block puzzle game designed around clear boards, simple rules, and structured logic. It offers a focused block puzzle experience where gameplay is easy to understand from the first move and remains consistent throughout each session.

In this block puzzle game, players place blocks of different shapes onto the board to complete full rows or columns. Clearing lines creates space and allows the block puzzle to continue. Each move requires planning and spatial awareness to keep the board playable for as long as possible.

Classic Block Puzzle Gameplay
Block Crush follows familiar classic block puzzle mechanics. Blocks appear in various shapes and must be placed carefully to avoid filling the board. Completing rows or columns clears space and keeps the block puzzle gameplay flowing without interruption.

The board layout remains clean and consistent, allowing players to focus entirely on block placement logic without time limits, pressure, or unnecessary visual distractions.

How to Play
• Place blocks onto the board
• Complete rows or columns to clear space
• Plan moves to manage available areas
• Continue playing as long as space remains
• Try a new daily block puzzle challenge
• Play offline anytime

Features
• Classic Block Puzzle Game — clear rules and simple logic
• Clean Board Design — easy to read and visually structured
• Daily Block Puzzle Mode — refreshed puzzle layouts each day
• Smooth Controls — intuitive drag-and-drop placement
• Offline Puzzle Play — no internet connection required
• No Ads Mode — uninterrupted block puzzle sessions

A Focused Block Puzzle Experience
Block Crush is a logic-based block puzzle built for players who enjoy structured gameplay and thoughtful decision-making. With consistent mechanics and readable boards, it delivers a reliable block puzzle experience suited for repeated play.

Download Block Crush and enjoy a classic block puzzle game with clean design, offline support, and straightforward gameplay—free to play and designed for focus.

items.description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

items.description:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

[Stay Connected]

versions.changelog:
[New Content]
1. Kingdom of Power Optimizations: 
Introducing "Duel of the Elites"—a new Cross-Kingdom group battle during the Preparation Phase! The top 150 Governors by Power from each Kingdom will clash in an epic showdown, competing to earn Preparation Point Boosts for their Kingdom and help secure the ultimate victory! (Please refer to the in-game rules for the official event rules.)
2. New Event: Blizzard Brawl
Warriors, assemble! The brawl begins! Whether competing in Same-Gen or Cross-Gen matches, you'll face off against other Governors on a dynamic battlefield and experience thrilling real-time combat. Strategy and execution are equally important—victory or defeat can be decided in an instant. Step onto the battlefield, prove your skill, and claim ultimate glory!

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Alliance Optimizations:
- R5 members can now add or remove Alliance members from the whitelist on the Alliance Members screen, making member management more convenient.
- Manual input has been added to the Alliance Resource Exchange screen for more convenient exchanges.
- A Starred Notice feature and a Starred Notice tab have been added to Alliance Notices, making it easier for Governors to quickly find important notices.
- Notices can now be pinned to make important information more prominent.
- A Like/Dislike option has been added. When enabled, Alliance members can react to notices with likes or dislikes, making feedback more visible.
- Mail notifications have been added for failed gathering attempts at Secured Alliance Gathering Node, providing more timely feedback.
- Once the Kingdom reaches the required progress, the "Claim All" button will remain permanently displayed on the Alliance Gift screen for easier claiming.
2. Position Optimizations:
- To further improve the Position system, a new "By Time Slot" reservation mode has been added alongside the existing "By Queue" mode for the King or High King to choose from. When "By Time Slot" is enabled, Governors can reserve Positions for specific time slots within the next 24 hours. (This feature will take effect after the first new King is crowned following the update.)
- The King or High King can enable automatic approval for reservation applications and set the minimum Town Center Level required to apply for Positions, making management more convenient.
- Position Reservation Task List display improvement: when a Governor reserves different Positions across multiple time slots, each reservation will be displayed separately in the Task List for greater clarity.
- A Position Application Blocklist has been added, allowing the King or High King to prevent specific Governors from applying for Positions, providing greater flexibility in Position management.
3. Rally Optimizations:
- Rally march queues now support a quick left-swipe action, allowing Rally Squads to be recalled more easily.
- When joining a Rally, the March Speedup screen now displays the Rally preparation countdown, making it easier to track both March and Rally progress.
- Rally time options have been adjusted. Terror Rallies can now be set to 3, 5, 10, or 15 minutes.
- Rallies against Elite Rebels, Dreadwolves, and personal Cesares Order targets can now be set to 3, 5, or 10 minutes, reducing wait times and improving Rally efficiency.

DELTA FORCE — ANNIVERSARY SEASON: REORIENTATION IS NOW LIVE!

Welcome back, veterans; welcome in, new recruits. This time, we're bringing you new maps, new modes, a new Operator, and an anniversary celebration built just for you.

A nuclear crisis is unfolding. This meltdown is yours to decide. Season MELTDOWN deploys a new Engineer Operator, a new Operations map, a new boss, a new Warfare map, and two new weapons—plus a legendary crossover waiting to be unlocked.

OPERATOR-BASED EXTRACTION SHOOTER
Join the G.T.I. and select from elite Operators, each equipped with unique tactical gadgets and traits. Whether you favor Detection Arrows, Magnetic Bombs, or Motorized Exoskeletons, coordinate your squad's abilities to outmaneuver rivals in high-stakes missions.

LOOTING HAS NEVER BEEN THIS FUN
Rediscover the thrill of looting. Explore dynamic maps to decipher entry codes, scale heights for Bird Nests, or dive deep to salvage Clams. Every raid offers a new treasure hunt, turning simple looting into an adrenaline-fueled adventure.

OUTSMART BOSSES. OUTGUN THE PLAYERS.
Take on heavily armed mercenaries and ruthless bosses guarding high-value loot. But stay sharp—the deadliest threat comes from rival Operator squads hunting the same prize. Fortune awaits those who can survive the crossfire and extract. No risk, no reward.

CHOOSE YOUR EXIT STRATEGY.
Extraction is an art form. Forget standard exit zones—launch a massive Rocket Extraction, base jump with a wingsuit, or crawl through long sewer pipes to slip away unseen. Adapt your escape plan to the chaos and exfil in spectacular style.

EXFIL AND UPGRADE YOUR OPERATIONS CENTER
Survival is just the beginning. Put your loot to good use--upgrade your Operations Center to enhance physical attributes, expand stash capacity, and unlock new gear. Every improvement opens more tactical possibilities, ensuring you return to the field stronger and better equipped.

DOMINATE LAND, SEA & AIR IN ALL-OUT WARFARE
Dive into Warfare, where 48 players clash in massive battles. Command tanks and helicopters across urban streets, mountain peaks, and expansive island terrain. Experience seamless combat on maps designed for total destruction.

EXTENSIVE ARMORY, EXTREME CUSTOMIZATION
Guided by military advisors, customize real-world weapons to create and share unique builds. Go beyond firearms by modifying land, sea, and air vehicles. Tailor your entire arsenal to dominate the battlefield on your terms.

MINIMUM DEVICE SPECIFICATIONS
iOS 12 or later, 2GB RAM or more, A10 Processor or better (iPhone 7 or newer, iPad 6 or newer)

RECOMMENDED DEVICE SPECIFICATIONS

items.description:
**Apex Hunter: Animal Shooting**

The title of Apex Hunter isn't given. It's earned—one bullet at a time.

Step into the world's most breathtaking wildernesses and become one of the world's most skilled hunters. In **Apex Hunter: Animal Shooting**, every hunt is the ultimate test of skill, precision, and will. From the scorching savannas of Africa to the frozen tundra of the Arctic, from the dense forests of North America to the rugged highlands of Asia, the world's most dangerous prey is waiting for you to pull the trigger.

**Global Hunting Grounds**
Explore hyper-realistic environments spanning the globe. These aren't just stunning landscapes; they are living arenas where every terrain demands a different strategy. Pull off long-range precision shots across open plains, track prey with patience through dense jungles, and push your accuracy to the limit in the biting cold of the tundra. Every hunting ground is a unique conquest and a true test of what you're made of.

**30+ Wild Animals**
Face Earth's deadliest creatures. Track down white-tailed deer, grizzly bears, mountain lions, moose, wolves, lions, leopards, crocodiles, wild boars, buffalo, and more! Every species moves and behaves differently. A successful hunt demands more than just aiming—you must read your prey, adapt your strategy, and seize control of the situation.

**Real Ballistics**
One shot. One kill. Perfected. Every shot in Apex Hunter pushes your focus and technique to the limit. Enjoy silky-smooth weapon handling and true-to-life precision where distance, wind, and timing make the difference between a shot and a missed opportunity. Precision isn't just a skill; it's the hunter's only language.

**Build Your Ultimate Arsenal**
There is no room for compromise in an apex hunter's arsenal. Unlock and upgrade a continuously expanding lineup of precision rifles and sniper weapons. Adapt your loadout to the terrain and the target in front of you. The arsenal of a true hunter never settles and never stops evolving.

**Varied Hunting Scenarios**
Aim like a sniper. Think like a tactician. Stay sharp and composed under pressure: fend off ferocious animal attacks, defend farms from predator invasions, and protect civilians caught in dangerous wildlife encounters. Every scenario demands a unique response. Only those who stay calm in every situation truly earn the title.

**Drone Recon & Trap Tactics**
A rifle is just the beginning. Take the high ground by commanding a drone to scout the terrain and pinpoint your target's location. Or play the long game: set strategic traps along animal paths to outsmart your prey. Advanced tactics mean multiple routes to a successful hunt.

Load your rifle, lace up your boots, and step into the unforgiving wild. Track footprints, hold your breath, squeeze the trigger—every shot is a test of your skill, every hit a conquest of the wild. Feel the sweeping vistas and realistic sounds of the wilderness wash over you, and let the adrenaline surge with every high-stakes moment.

Are you ready to track, aim, and take that one defining shot?

**Download Apex Hunter: Animal Shooting now—the wild is calling. Answer it.**

items.short_description: Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing and engaging 3D puzzle experience where observation, timing, and planning come together. Rotate the cube, release…
items.description:
Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing and engaging 3D puzzle experience where observation, timing, and planning come together.
Rotate the cube, release arrows, and clear surfaces gradually. Careful observation and thoughtful decisions help create smooth clearing sequences and solve spatial challenges that gradually become more complex.
The controls are simple to understand, while puzzle layouts continue to encourage deeper thinking as progress continues.

- A fully rotatable 3D puzzle environment
Arrow Pro 3D takes place on an interactive three-dimensional cube. Unlike flat puzzle designs, every face contributes to the overall solution. At times, the answer may be located on the opposite side, requiring rotation and observation from different angles.
Players can rotate the cube freely, zoom in to inspect details, and study each surface before choosing the next move. This freedom allows exploration and supports thoughtful planning throughout each level.

- Release arrows and clear surfaces
The core mechanic focuses on releasing arrows in the correct order. Tap an arrow to activate it, and they will travel forward along its direction, removing other arrows encountered along the path.
Some arrows travel short distances, while others move across larger areas. Understanding how arrows interact allows multiple elements to be removed efficiently. Careful sequencing often creates satisfying chain reactions that clear large sections of the cube.

- Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles
Arrow Pro 3D contains a wide collection of handcrafted puzzles designed to maintain interest over time. Early challenges introduce fundamental behavior and basic movement patterns. As progress continues, layouts expand and require stronger observation and structured planning.
Players will encounter:
 - Beginner-friendly compact cube layouts
 - Medium difficulty spatial arrangements
 - Large cube structures requiring careful reasoning
 - Multi-stage solutions that reward planning and patience
Each layout presents a different arrangement that supports flexible thinking and encourages experimentation.

- Smooth and relaxing interactions
The overall experience focuses on steady pacing and visual clarity. Arrows glide across cube surfaces in a fluid motion. As elements disappear gradually, the cube becomes less crowded, creating a consistent visual rhythm.
A minimalist visual approach keeps attention on puzzle solving while maintaining readability during longer play sessions. Subtle animations provide visual feedback without distraction.

- Develop thinking skills naturally
Arrow Pro 3D offers a structured way to exercise reasoning skills while maintaining a calm environment.
Regular play supports:
 - Spatial awareness
 - Logical reasoning
 - Planning ability
 - Pattern recognition
 - Problem-solving confidence
Players may spend time studying layouts carefully or proceed quickly through simpler puzzles. Each session supports observation and structured thinking.

- Designed for flexible play sessions
Whether there are only a few minutes available or a longer period of time, Arrow Pro 3D adapts comfortably to different schedules.Short puzzle layouts fit brief moments of play. Larger structures support longer sessions that encourage focused attention.
Suitable moments to play include:
 - During short breaks
 - While traveling
 - Before rest
 - During quiet moments
The structure supports gradual progression while maintaining a balanced level of challenge. Early puzzles provide clear learning opportunities, while later layouts require deeper reasoning and patience. Completing a puzzle often feels similar to solving a small mechanical structure.

Shielded targets, splitting targets, rolling giants, flying saucers, metal brutes that deflect your knives… every stage brings a new twist to outsmart.

■ Unlock new ways to throw
Shurikens, boomerangs, blazing trails, chain lightning — each unlock changes how you draw your line.

■ A world of pure neon
Minimal, glowing, and satisfying — visual and audio feedback tuned for that perfect "aaah" moment.

Perfect for a quick, satisfying break — or a deep arcade session.
Five minutes turns into "just one more stage" before you know it.

Stop time. Draw your line. Let them fly.

Play the original classic Hill Climb Racing! Race your way uphill in this physics based driving game, playable offline!

Meet Bill, the young aspiring uphill racer. He is about to embark on a journey through Climb Canyon that takes him to where no ride has ever been before. With little respect to the laws of physics, Bill will not rest until he has conquered the highest hills up on the moon!

Face challenges in unique hill climbing environments with a wide variety of cars to choose from. Earn points from daring tricks and collect coins to upgrade your car and travel further distances. Watch out though - Bill's neck is not what it used to be when he was a kid! And his good old gasoline crematorium will easily run out of fuel.

Features::

Fresh Content
We are still actively developing Hill Climb Racing and adding new vehicles, new stages and new content! 

Unique Vehicles
Get behind the wheel of a wide variety of different vehicles. From the iconic Hill Climber to bikes, race cars, trucks and even some outlandish vehicles such as the creepy Carantula! Half car, half tarantula, do you dare drive it?

Play Offline
Race offline whenever and wherever you want! Hill Climb Racing is playable completely offline. Play it on a bus, plane or train! Play it anywhere!

Wacky Stages
Climb Canyon is full of unique challenges and stages for you to overcome with vastly different terrains and hazards. How far can you drive without running out of gas or crashing your vehicle?

Unlock and Upgrade
Tune up and fix your dream vehicle with custom parts, skins and upgrades!

Simulated Physics
We worked hard on creating a one of a kind in-game physics system where your vehicles will react to the terrain in a unique manner, can you use this to your advantage and conquer the hills? 

Daily challenges and events
Tackle the daily challenges and events to earn epic rewards!

items.description:
From the acclaimed Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six franchise, Rainbow Six Mobile is a competitive online tactical action shooter FPS built specifically for online mobile action. Engage in intense 5v5 multiplayer FPS matches inspired by Rainbow Six Siege’s iconic Attack vs. Defense gameplay. Alternate roles every round as you play Attacker or Defender in fast-paced online combat. Experience close-quarter shooter action where teamwork, positioning, and map knowledge make the difference. Choose from a roster of elite Operators from Rainbow Six Siege, each designed for action tactical team play with unique abilities and gadgets. Every map offers new strategic possibilities, demanding coordination, precision, and smart decisions. 

Rainbow Six Mobile delivers a true FPS action shooter experience, adapted for mobile platforms. 

MOBILE ADAPTATION – Rainbow Six Mobile has been developed and optimized for mobile devices, delivering smooth online gameplay, intuitive controls, and shorter 5v5 FPS matches. Customize your HUD, adjust controls to your playstyle, and jump into tactical combat anywhere, anytime. This mobile shooter supports responsive touch controls and controller compatibility for competitive action on the go. 

RAINBOW SIX EXPERIENCE – Experience the authentic Rainbow Six Siege on mobile. Play on legendary maps such as Bank, Clubhouse, Border, Oregon, and Villa. Each map is designed for tactical team coordination and intense 5v5 online combat. Squad up with friends and players worldwide in thrilling multiplayer action FPS battles. 

TACTICAL SHOOTER GAME – Rainbow Six Mobile, like Rainbow Six Siege, is an action-tactical shooter focused on realistic combat. Clear angles, gather intel with drones and cameras, and adapt your strategy to every map. Smart decisions, teamwork, and preparation are essential to dominate this online action FPS. 

DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENTS – Use destruction to your advantage in close-quarter combat. Break walls, doors, and hatches to reshape the map and create new tactical opportunities. Every map becomes a dynamic battlefield where strategy and action collide in intense shooter gameplay. 

STRATEGIC TEAM-BASED PVP – Strategy and teamwork are the keys to success in Rainbow Six Mobile. Adapt your strategy to each map, role, and situation in competitive 5v5 online combat. Attackers gather intel and breach defenses, while Defenders fortify positions and control the map. True tactical action shooter gameplay rewards communication and planning. 

SPECIALIZED OPERATORS – Build your team with highly trained Operators from Rainbow Six Siege. Each Operator brings unique weapons, gadgets, and abilities to the battlefield. Mastering Operators is key to success in this competitive online shooter. 

NEW MONTHLY SEASON – Every month, discover new action with fresh Operators, Battle Pass content, limited-time online modes, events, and cosmetics. Keep your team ready for evolving combat challenges across new and familiar maps. 

This game requires an online connection (4G, 5G, or Wi-Fi).

Assemble your own team of versatile Mortal Kombat fighters and lead them into battle to earn experience, level up your attacks, and knock out the kompetition in Faction Wars. Each fighter has a set of unique attacks, like Sindel’s Banshee Scream, and Kabal’s Dash and Hook. Strategize with different team combinations such as the MK11 team or Day of the Dead team to maximize synergies and get an advantage over your enemies.

EPIC FRIENDSHIPS & BRUTALITIES
Mortal Kombat brings its trademark Friendships and Brutalities to mobile! Equip your Diamond fighters with the right Gear and unleash these over-the-top and iconic moves. Hug your evil twin with Kitana’s Friendship. Feel the power of Nightwolf’s Tomahawk with his Skull Cracker Brutality!

Shang Tsung’s Krypt awaits! Choose your own path and crawl through the Krypt to find hidden treasures that lie beyond the Fog. Explore and fight through the map to earn Krypt Hearts and Konsumables to unlock featured Diamond Fighters and Equipment!

Compete and fight with other players in Faction Wars, an online competitive arena mode where players duel against other player’s teams. Climb the ranks of your Faction’s leaderboard to earn seasonal prizes.

Prove yourself in epic battles and complete a series of matches to bring new Mortal Kombat warriors to your roster! Come back every week to take on different fighting Challenges and kontinue to expand and level up your game Kollection with fighters like Jade, Sub-Zero, and Goro!

FEATS OF STRENGTH
Unlock unique Mortal Kombat profile and victory kustomizations by completing certain character objectives! Design your War Banner to show off in Faction War fights and gain Kombat stat bonuses by unlocking certain Feats of Strength.

Download this groundbreaking, free fighting game TODAY and unleash your power!

On Earth-90214, in 1930s New York, Peter B. Parker is the nephew of the activist Aunt May with a strong hatred for crime, particularly towards those who killed his Uncle Ben. When following a criminal tip led to an accident, he gained arachnid-like abilities when bit by a spider. Publicly he’s a Private Investigator, but secretly he uses his powers to take down crime as the hardboiled Spider-Man Noir.

Gwenom
While Gwen Stacy faced the mutated Venom Symbiote of Earth-65, the Kingpin known as Matt Murdock revealed that her father had been beaten into a coma by Rhino with little to no chance of survival. Fueled by rage, Gwen gave into the rhythms of her heart and let the symbiote take over, granting her immense destructive power and turning her into the most unstable, broken version of herself: Gwenom. 

Green Goblin (Stellar-Forged) 
The Eidol known as Lumatrix has decided to augment a Champion of their own to better cause chaos and mayhem within The Battlerealm. Norman Osborn bargained and threatened to get access to this upgrade and this insatiable hunger for power impressed the unstable Eidol. So now Green Goblin takes to the skies with sinister science at his command! 


NEW QUESTS AND EVENTS


Event Quest - Shadow Of A Doubt
There’s trouble here, big trouble with a capital B and an on fire “Trouble”. The kind of trouble that lurks in dark alleys and makes the shadows nervous. Lucky for you the most talented web-swinging detective in the Multiverse has wall-crawled his way into The Contest. But will SPIDER-MAN NOIR be enough to crack this case of corruption, confusion, and challenging Champions? One thing is for sure, the addition of GWENOM will be making for more menacing mysteries!


Side-Quest - Monochrome Mystery
At the end of September a mystery is afoot! Complete special Solo Objectives and fight in a special Arena to gather Evidence in the Monochrome Mystery Event! As you gain progress you’ll earn many excellent prizes as well as Clues to solve the mystery!


New Event - Wakandan Challenge Rituals
One map. Five Defenders. Five increasing levels of difficulty for your team to face off against on even footing. This Gauntlet will challenge your roster all the way from 3-Star to 7-Star rarities with your full team swapping out between Paths. The final Path adds a bonus challenger just to ensure you’ve truly demonstrated your unquestionable skills in battle. 

By completing all 5x Paths in a single run can you claim a free First Appearance 7-Star Cable!


Epilogue Part 3: Vicious Variances
The Quest to reconstruct a 7-STAR CARINA TIVAN and banish the last shadows of the Chronoserpent continues! Face down a lethal Laura and a menacing Mjolnir to gain the next pieces!


Pump It Up Showcase - Tower
Featuring both Stone and Water Tactics, Defender Mastery loadouts, and a special Block for Saga attackers, the PUMP IT UP SHOWCASE is now permanently available in the Saga Showcase Tower.




All this and more! Check out the complete list of exciting updates on playcontestofchampions.com

items.description:
Embark on an action roguelike RPG adventure with Rogue Legend, where every battle makes your hero stronger.

In Rogue Legend, you journey through worlds filled with monsters, treasures, and powerful bosses. Each run is a new roguelike RPG experience of strategy, combat, and growth, giving you the chance to strengthen your hero and push further with every run.



Enter a World of Endless Battles:
Every session begins in the lobby. Press Play and roll the dice to start your roguelike RPG run, diving into a board-based action RPG full of encounters and surprises.

As your hero moves across the board, different events unfold depending on where you land:

* Enemy Tiles: Engage in fast, automatic roguelike RPG battles. After each fight, choose one of three upgrades to shape your build.
* Buff Tiles: Gain boosts to attack, defense, and speed to help your hero survive longer in Rogue Legend’s idle-friendly dungeons.
* Negative Tiles: Face debuffs that test your timing and strategic decisions.
* Minigame Tiles: Roll for luck in short events where you can win extra loot or power-ups.
* Shop Tiles: Spend gold to buy new gear, upgrades, and legendary equipment.
* Special Tiles: Additional tile types will be added over time to expand Rogue Legend’s gameplay depth.


Defeat Bosses and Grow Stronger:
Your goal is to survive, adapt, and conquer every boss battle. Each fight is an opportunity to grow stronger, unlocking new roguelike RPG challenges, rewards, and abilities that prepare your hero for the next run in this idle RPG adventure.



Upgrade, Progress, and Customize Your Hero:
Between runs, return to the lobby to enhance your hero through Rogue Legend’s RPG progression systems:
* Gear System: Collect and upgrade your weapons, armor, and equipment. Collect S weapons!
* Talent System: Level up to unlock new stats, passive abilities, and bonuses that fit your playstyle.
* Pet System: Obtain and train pets that join you in combat.
* Hero Collection: Collect more heroes to unlock new strategies, then level and ascend them to raise their base power. Swap heroes to match different boards, enemies, and builds.
* Mounts: Equip & ride mounts that grant powerful stat bonuses and combat perks
* …and more progression systems to discover as you climb!


Roguelike Depth with Idle RPG Progression
Rogue Legend blends the excitement of roguelike gameplay with the satisfaction of RPG and idle progression. Each run feels fast, rewarding, and different. The board and dice mechanics make every move matter, while the idle RPG design ensures steady progress without repetitive grind.


A Journey of Strategy and Power:
If you enjoy roguelike action, RPG adventure, and idle gameplay, Rogue Legend delivers a journey of endless replayability.
Fight, roll, and rise again in Rogue Legend, the roguelike idle RPG where every battle shapes your hero’s fate.

items.description:
A new kind of Mario game that you can play with one hand.

You control Mario by tapping as he constantly runs forward. You time your taps to pull off stylish jumps, midair spins, and wall jumps to gather coins and reach the goal!

Super Mario Run can be downloaded for free and after you purchase the game, you will be able to play all the modes with no additional payment required. You can try out all four modes before purchase: World Tour, Toad Rally, Remix 10, and Kingdom Builder.

■World Tour
Run and jump with style to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser’s clutches! 
Travel through plains, caverns, ghost houses, airships, castles, and more.

Clear the 24 exciting courses to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser, waiting in his castle at the end. There are many ways to enjoy the courses, such as collecting the 3 different types of colored coins or by competing for the highest score against your friends. You can try courses 1-1 to 1-4 for free.

After rescuing Princess Peach, a nine-course special world, World Star, will appear.

■Remix 10
Some of the shortest Super Mario Run courses you'll ever play!
This mode is Super Mario Run in bite-sized bursts! You'll play through 10 short courses one after the other, with the courses changing each time you play. Daisy is lost somewhere in Remix 10, so try to clear as many courses as you can to find her!

■Toad Rally
Show off Mario’s stylish moves, compete against your friends, and challenge people from all over the world.

In this challenge mode, the competition differs each time you play.
Compete against the stylish moves of other players for the highest score as you gather coins and get cheered on by a crowd of Toads. Fill the gauge with stylish moves to enter Coin Rush Mode to get more coins. If you win the rally, the cheering Toads will come live in your kingdom, and your kingdom will grow. 

■Kingdom Builder
Gather coins and Toads to build your very own kingdom.

Combine different buildings and decorations to create your own unique kingdom. There are over 100 kinds of items in Kingdom Builder mode. If you get more Toads in Toad Rally, the number of buildings and decorations available will increase. With the help of the friendly Toads you can gradually build up your kingdom.

■What You Can Do After Purchasing All Worlds

・ All courses in World Tour are playable
Why not try out the bigger challenges and thrills available in all courses?

・ Easier to get Rally Tickets
It's easier to get Rally Tickets that are needed to play Remix 10 and Toad Rally. You can collect them in Kingdom Builder through Bonus Game Houses and ? Blocks, by collecting colored coins in World Tour, and more.

・ More playable characters
If you rescue Princess Peach by completing course 6-4 and build homes for Luigi, Yoshi, and Toadette in Kingdom Builder mode, you can get them to join your adventures as playable characters. They play differently than Mario, so why not put their special characteristics to good use in World Tour and Toad Rally?

・ More courses in Toad Rally
The types of courses available in Toad Rally will increase to seven different types of courses, expanding the fun! Along with the new additions, Purple and Yellow Toads may also come to cheer for you.

・ More buildings and decorations in Kingdom Builder
The types of buildings available will increase, so you'll be able to make your kingdom even more lively. You can also place Rainbow Bridges to expand your kingdom.

・ Play Remix 10 without having to wait
You can play Remix 10 continuously, without having to wait between each game.

*Internet connectivity required to play. Data charges may apply. May contain advertisements.

Challenge yourself in the ultimate sandbox experience with Flex City, where the heart-pounding thrill of driving and racing games takes center stage. Unite in gangs and rule the streets in this multiplayer online sandbox game, where every decision shapes your destiny in a vibrant gangster city.

GAME FEATURES

Gang Wars and Strategic Alliances:

In Flex City gang wars are more than just street battles; they're intricate power struggles requiring strategic thinking and alliances. Form or join gangs, build alliances, and navigate the underworld politics in this intense multiplayer sandbox game. Experience the thrill of territorial battles and the challenge of maintaining relationships in the ever-shifting landscape of gangster city alliances.

Vast and Dynamic Open World:

The open world in Flex City is not just expansive; it's teeming with life and opportunities. From high-rise buildings to the gritty streets, every corner of this grand auto adventure offers unique encounters and discoveries. Explore diverse neighborhoods, each with its own character and secrets, making exploration a key part of the sandbox driving game experience.

Realistic Driving Simulator:

Flex City driving simulator is meticulously crafted, providing a top-tier car driving experience. Choose from a wide range of vehicles, each with distinct handling and performance characteristics. Customize your cars for different missions, experience high-speed chases, or enjoy leisurely drives around the open world. This feature elevates the standard of car driving and racing games, and drift competitions.

Advanced Shooting and Combat System:

As a standout among shooting games, Flex City offers a robust combat system. Engage in tactical gunfights, utilize cover, and master various shooting styles. The game's arsenal is diverse, ranging from handguns to heavy weapons, each offering a unique combat experience within the criminal underworld.

Deep Character Customization:

The roleplay aspect in Flex City is enriched with deep character customization options. Shape your character's appearance, skills, and even moral standing. Your choices in attire, weapons, and skills directly influence your interactions and reputation in the gangster city, blending seamlessly with the car driving and grand criminal elements of the game.

Complex Economic System:

Flex City economic system adds a strategic layer to this grand auto adventure. Engage in various legal and illicit activities to grow your financial empire. Trade, invest, and use your economic savvy to gain an edge in the criminal world.

Community Events and Missions:

items.description:
Blocky Quest – A real blockbuster!

► New kid on the block 

If you’re a fan of block puzzles, then welcome to a brand-new block puzzle game offering a unique and refreshing twist on the classic gameplay and format. Download Blocky Quest now and dive into an awesome, never-ending block party of a game!

The features block:

◾ A chip off the old block: Packed with features and beautifully designed, Blocky Quest takes a legend and runs with it, providing a rewarding and addictive puzzle experience for players young and old, bricks game is fanatics and all fans of challenging and dynamic brainteasers.

◾ The blocks don’t drop:  Unlike in traditional building block games, in Blocky Quest you don’t have to fit the blocks on the board as they fall. In fact, you’ve got all the time in the world to try to find the best position. This makes the game more like a jigsaw puzzle, but it doesn’t make it any less fun or infuriating.

◾ The twist is… There’s no twisting! In contrast with other brick games, you can’t turn the blocks around here, you have to work out how to fit them together along the axis they appear. Unless you’re ready to use boosters, that is…

◾ Feeling blocked? Blocky Quest features a range of boosters to help you out of tough spots in puzzles. Earn up to five different types of boosters as you play, then use them to twist, blast, sweep or slam your way past whatever’s blocking your next move.

◾ Feeling adventurous? Alongside classic gameplay, where you can keep slotting the blocks into place endlessly to carry on surviving and achieve a new high score, there are also quests, where levels have specific goals and winning multiple levels brings you chests with extra rewards.

◾ On a quest: Can you match all the blocks with the right gems to reach the target? Or will you be able to puzzle out the mess on the board at the start of the level and get the necessary score? If not, you’ll just have to try again to pass the brick game levels and complete the quest. The rewards are worth it!

► On a quest for a great puzzle game?

Looking for a new take on classic games with fun new features, addictive gameplay, and stylish packaging? Blocky Quest is guaranteed to rock your block, combining tried and tested puzzle features from much-loved old games with genuinely original and engaging new mechanics that will test your puzzle brain and your spatial awareness, while also providing a relaxing and absorbing gameplay environment to soothe stress and help you relax whenever you have a spare five minutes. Install Blocky Quest now and get ready to set out on a real puzzle adventure!

items.description:
Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards. 

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

items.description:
THE CATACOMB OPENS. THE CRUX IS YOURS.

Beneath the stone, two paths diverge — and only you choose which vault to plunder first.

Slot Crux: Catacomb is a landscape fantasy relic hunt built for quick, satisfying sessions. No account. No internet. No real-money wagering. Just torchlight, runes, dice, and the slow burn of a decision you might regret.

▸ TWO ADVENTURES, ONE VAULT

◆ GATE & RUNE — The Rune Chamber
Four glowing gates. One hidden fate behind each.
Spend STAMINA to reveal Runes and stack your round POINTS pot:
  • VOID — the round dies. The pot is gone.
  • FOUNDATION — steady gains. Keep digging.
  • POTENTIAL — bigger hauls. Multiplier climbs.
  • GREED — the Seal crossroads: bank and DOUBLE, or push deeper.

Fill the Magic Sword to 18 for the grand prize. Seal early when the vault glows — or tempt the void one gate too far.

◆ DRAGON BOARD — The Serpent Path
Roll the die. March your explorer along a dragon-shaped trail of 36 steps.
Land on tiles for coins and chest fragments. Collect four of a kind, merge them into a chest slot, then beat the 60-second countdown before the lock clicks shut.
Reach the dragon's head. Earn your mark. Begin again.

▸ ENERGY STATION
Refill POINTS and STAMINA without leaving the tomb:
  • Daily Claim — free bundle every 24 hours
  • Exchange — rebalance resources on demand
  • Surprise — risk a little for a random bonus roll

▸ JOURNEY UPGRADES
Level each adventure from Lv1 to Lv10. Richer rewards — but every gate and every roll costs more STAMINA. Focus one path at a time. Commit in EVENTS.

▸ BUILT FOR THE DARK
• Fully offline — progress saved on device
• Landscape-only — wide vault views
• Synthesized fantasy soundscape — gates, runes, chests, dragon roars
• In-game guides on every screen — no wiki required

Some vaults reward the bold. Some punish the greedy. Every rune flip and every die roll lands on the crux.

Will you seal the pot, or chase the dragon's head?

Download Slot Crux: Catacomb. Light your torch. Choose your path.

items.short_description: Pixel Gun 2 is a multiplayer shooter built on disruption — of old rules, map architecture, traditional loadouts and more! Short matches. Destructible…
items.description:
Pixel Gun 2 is a multiplayer shooter built on disruption — of old rules, map architecture, traditional loadouts and more! 

Short matches. Destructible arenas. Wild builds. Non-stop FPS action. Ever-evolving world. A piece of controlled mayhem that fits in your pocket — or takes over your evening. Jump in for a few PvP battles or lose track of time (with no regrets).

Experiment with loadouts, improvise in ever-changing environments, embrace the chaos, and make the most out of the reality-bending Pixelstorm!

EVERY MATCH HITS DIFFERENT
Change is the only constant in Pixel Gun 2. The battle arena starts falling apart with every shot fired. Creative builds clash, throwing surprises at everyone involved.

As the PvP match goes on, you evolve too — stacking perks, adapting on the fly, and leaning into whatever the situation demands. Will you end up a life-stealing headshot machine, a melee juggernaut, a speed-running gadgeteer — or something nobody saw coming?

Next time it will be different. And that’s the point.

WRECK HAVOC. MAKE A MESS
Pixel Gun 2 maps are breaking apart — and you’d better take advantage of it.

Use the destructible environment for smart tactical moves or just for the sake of pure fun. No cover is built to last. If something’s in your way — blow a hole through it. If someone’s camping — make a few “architectural adjustments” to their hiding spot.

You’re not here to build. You’re here to destroy. The battlefield keeps changing — and so do your options.

YOUR CHARACTER. YOUR BUILD. YOUR VIBE
Pixel Gun 2 is all about playing your way.

Mix characters, weapons, gadgets, armor, perks, and abilities into builds that feel powerful, clever, aggressive, weird — or all of the above.

Get creative. Break the meta. Find something that just clicks.

CROSS DIMENSIONS. MORE PLATFORMS AHEAD.
Start your journey on mobile, with Pixel Gun 2 coming to PC in the future. Cross-platform play and shared progression are planned, so your progress and rewards can travel with you between devices.
Play now — and stay tuned for PC release news.

THE PIXELSTORM IS RISING
The world of Pixel Gun 2 isn’t about order or stability — it’s about constant change and adaptation.

A strange calamity keeps bending the rules of reality, opening new possibilities (and dangers) over time. New heroes, gear, abilities, seasons, game modes, and even entire worlds appear in this ever-shifting multiverse.

Pixel Gun 2 is a mobile first-person shooter that evolves around — and for — you. Expect the unexpected.

New Wishlie Hospital
You were getting your daily treatment with friends at the New Wishlie Hospital for 2 weeks already, and today was time to get discharged from the hospital. But something happened. You woke up at 2 AM and found out that all the patients were gone, except you and your friends. The place looks much muddier and it’s... locked! You read in magazines about the hospital and turns out that it's haunted. Now It seems like the only way to escape is through the garage door. Will you be able to get away by the time the ghost devours your soul?



High School
Emily and Leila were studends and best friends. They lived in a small house in a town with almost no people. It was Sunday, and it was routinuous for them to visit the cemetery together. Only this time, for some reasons, Emily felt she would better stay home. So she decided to stay home. Looking out of window, Emily sees strange creature creeping behind her sister... The next day after Leila's absence, she runs to school for help. On her way to get inside the school, the main school gate closes behind her. Now locked inside the school area, the next thing she notices are students who struggle to survive...



Apartments
Waking up you realized that you were stuck in a cursed apartment. You and your friends need to use elevator to reach the first floor and exit the building. But it's not as easy as it seems: when you miss an anomaly on one floor, the elevator will glitch and take you back to the highest floor. Even more: there are monsters, ghosts and maniacs lurking on floors.

Play with up to 5 players.
Play as survivor - escape the place.
Play as the ghost - don't let the survivors escape.
Choose Exit 8 game mode to play Apartments in guessing mode.

items.description:
ColorLookFu is an offline color puzzle game built around clean pure-color puzzle blocks. Players choose a board from the gallery, drag pieces into place, and complete each color composition at their own pace.

Core Features

- Completely offline gameplay
- English interface
- Pure-color puzzle pieces
- Multiple board sizes from relaxed 5x5 puzzles to harder 12x12 challenges
- Drag-and-drop piece movement
- Animated piece movement and animated completion popup
- Hint assistance
- Auto Place support
- Shuffle support
- Adjustable piece opacity
- Local color coins earned through puzzle completion
- Coin shop for border skins and wallpaper styles
- Gallery search by name and category
- Favorite level collection
- Local records, best times, and achievement badges
- Background music, click sound, completion sound, and haptic feedback settings
- Local save progress without account login or personal information upload

How To Play

Open ColorLookFu and choose Start, Continue, or Gallery. In the puzzle screen, drag color blocks to swap their positions. Use Hint when you need help finding a piece, Auto Place to place one piece correctly, or Shuffle to restart the current board arrangement. Complete the full board to earn color coins and update your local records.

Ever wanted to shave an alpaca, shower an adorable but filthy elephant calf, lead a column of acrobatic chimpanzees all the way to the banana pile, or throw watermelons to a ravening hippo? These are just a few of the crazy, cute and super fun tasks you’ll have to perform to keep the animals happy in this colorful, delightful zoo simulator that offers a whole range of entertaining mini games that challenge, charm and amuse in equal measure, covering all aspects of zoo life and animal care. 
Become a zoo tycoon and master every aspect of animal welfare in this awesome idle animal game, just don’t let the lions get in with the alpacas, and watch your hands when you’re feeding the crocodiles…

► How about you?

• Can you master all the skills required to run a zoo? There’s always work for idle hands, with feeding, grooming, washing, and herding all covered in a wide range of entertaining and instructive mini games that include maze puzzles, moving pins, obstacle courses, cutting, catching and a whole lot more.

• Who’s the cutest of them all? Look after fluffy alpacas, playful baby elephants, cheeky little monkeys, lovely lion cubs, and huggable hippos. Even those snap-happy crocodiles are kind of adorable. Complete the game levels to meet their needs and get rewarded with happiness and love expressed in dance, emojis and the occasional wholehearted roar.

• Charming graphics, fun animations, and entertaining haptic effects make the Zoo a colorful, absorbing, and super relaxing place to spend time for animal lovers of all ages, relieving stress for adults and helping develop cognitive and fine motor skills in young children.

• With an emphasis on fun, simple gameplay and a beautiful game world, Zoo helps build awareness of animal welfare and protection, as well as respect for nature, while maintaining a sense of joy and age-appropriate humor.

► You can come too!

Rate your chances as a zoo tycoon? Want an idle game that lets you indulge your overwhelming love for animals in a simulator that also boasts gorgeous gameplay, fun puzzle challenges, and original wacky humor? Want to build a zoo where all the animals are kept happy all the time, and every species lives in peace, love and harmony?

True Cross-Platform Gameplay

items.description:
► SORT YOUR WAY TO HAPPINESS

Master mergers, ready those fingers and get to matching in 3…2…1! This fun sorting puzzle features colorful coins that need to be matched up in their slots and then merged together to clear the playing field, making way for more. Bright colors, simple graphics, and lots of boosters ensure that your brain can focus on what it does best: noticing patterns and finding unique ways to shuffle everything around in order to win.
 
► MASTER THE MATCH

Simple in theory yet difficult in practice, players young and old will enjoy racking their brains for the best possible way to merge the different color coins and keep progressing. With no timer or pressure to trip you up, you’ll be able to sort, match, and merge the coins while also relaxing.

Fun features:

● Tons of coin types – In addition to your standard rainbow of coins to match, as you progress there will be all manner or fun new coins to keep things fresh. Hidden coins, linked coins, ice coins, and more await, so keep your eyes peeled!

● Easy on the eye – As colorful as this sorting puzzle is, the whole point is to help you chill so we’ve done away with any crazy graphics or flashing lights. This also means the game is great to play wherever you find yourself, solo or perhaps with a little helper.

● Relaxing to play – No countdown clock here! Take as much time on each puzzle as you need, and move the coins around as much as you want without being penalized. We believe in having fun, not getting stressed.

● Train your brain – Sorting and matching puzzles are a great way to train your brain to recognize patterns and colors, and to work on your logic and thinking skills as you test out different ways to group coins. And it doesn’t stop there, the skills you hone in the game can be applied to other stuff in real life.

● Keep growing – As you progress through the puzzle levels, more colors and coin types will be added, and things will get steadily more difficult. But no fear, even as you’re pushed to get better we’ve added plenty of fun boosters to keep it chill.

► GO ON A COLORFUL ADVENTURE

Ready to start your merge adventure? This relaxing game keeps your mind sharp while also providing a fun escape as you enjoy sorting and matching, so hop on in to become the master sorter and put all this stuff where it needs to be!

Download Pocket Sort: Coin Puzzle today to see how good you are at locating different colored coins and slotting them in together.

Mahjong Master is a classic tile-matching game designed for those who love a mental challenge. While the rules are familiar, the experience is strictly about logic and strategy. Unlike casual relaxation games, we treat every level as a unique puzzle to be solved.

By peeling back layers systematically and avoiding dead ends, your objective is to clear every single tile from the board to solve the logic puzzle and master the challenge.

Classic & Authentic – No distractions. Just you and the traditional Mahjong tiles. We focus on the essence of the classic board game experience.
Sharp & Clear Visuals – We use Extra Large Tiles with high-contrast symbols. The interface is clean and crisp, ensuring you never miss a match due to poor visibility.
Progressive Difficulty – Starts easy to help you learn the logic, then ramps up to complex, multi-layered structures that will truly test your patience and skill.
Strategic Tools – Stuck on a tough layer? Use Hints to find hidden pairs or Undo to correct a mistake. Use tools to learn, not just to win.

items.description:
Dominican partner dominoes in 3D.

The table is set

In the Caribbean, dominoes isn't a pastime. It's a conversation. It gets played outside the corner store, under the carport, at the end of a meal nobody wants to end. DR Dominoes brings that table to your screen: same rules, same tension, same people. Even if they're three thousand miles away.

Tiles in 3D with real weight, real light, real sound. A table you can read at a glance. No endless menus. Just you, your partner, and seven tiles.

The table talks

Dominoes is won with your hand and played with your mouth. This isn't flat voice chat where everybody comes through the same channel at the same volume. This is a table — and at a table, everybody has a chair.

Proximity voice chat: you hear every player from where they're sitting. Your partner, across from you. The one about to lock up the table, on your left. You hear him coming.

Text chat: for when you don't want the mic on — or when the comment deserves to be in writing.

The table sounds like a table: the slap of a tile on wood, the guy complaining, and the one who already knows what's coming and hasn't said a word.

House rules

Double-six set. 28 tiles. Four players, two teams.

No boneyard, no drawing. Seven tiles each — you play what you were dealt, or you pass.

Leads, passes, blocked games, capicúas. The whole vocabulary, nothing trimmed.

Games to 100, 120, 150 or 200 points. You decide whether it's a quick round or a war.

The chain turns the corner when it runs out of table, just like the real thing. No tiles wandering off into nowhere.

Get a game going

Offline mode: the full table against the AI. No internet, no excuses.

Private rooms: share a code and everybody's seated in seconds.

Room browser: drop into a public table that's still filling up.

Reconnect: if your connection drops, your chair is still there.

Stats: your profile keeps count. Wins, blocks, win rate — everything you'll need the next time somebody doubts you.

When nobody's around

The AI in DR Dominoes isn't there to fill seats. It counts tiles, remembers what you passed on, and locks up the table when you least expect it. Use it to practice, to round out a partnership, or just to play in peace on a Sunday afternoon.

Pull up a chair. Shuffle. And don't get caught holding the double six.
