Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). People also misspell Ludo as Loodo, Lido, Lado, Ledo, Leedo, Laado, or Lodo. 

Ludo's versions are Trouble, Sorry, Aeroplane chess, Chopat, Chaupur, Pachisi or Parcheesi.

Features of Ludo King:
•	No internet connection required! Play against the computer.
•	Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer.
•	Play with 2 to 6 Players in Local Multiplayer Mode.
•	Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a Private Game Room and beat them to become Ludo King.
•	Play with world players and make them your buddies.
•	Private Chat with your Facebook friends & Buddies.
•	Play Snake and Ladders on 7 different gameboards.
•	Simple rules which can be followed by players of all ages.

Play the game of Kings with your family and friends. While the gameplay might seem simple at first, the game is immensely enjoyable and challenging. It’s fun for the whole family; You’ll be playing this one for hours. Try to beat your opponents and compete for the highest scores on the leaderboards.

How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

Get comfy, choose a cocktail, and get ready for a very special game of pool. Assemble a triangle of balls with strange effects and get the sickest trickshots. The bartenders won't be easy to impress!

Ultrapool is an arcade-y colorful roguelike that plays like a pool version of Balatro and Super Auto Pets. Pocketing balls gives you score, and extra score gives you money you can spend at the bar to buy and improve your set of balls. Try to survive 10 rounds!

We got both! Easy to pick up pool mechanics: just get the balls in the holes! But as you discover the wacky abilities the balls have, you'll get new ideas of how to get your score ever higher.

A ghost ball that reappears on the table? A chicken ball that lays spherical eggs? A bomb that explodes if you bump it too much? The Earth? Anything is possible (as long as it's round and it rolls nicely, no cubes allowed!) 

Once you think you know the game, the cocktail bar opens. Ask the bartender to mix any two balls and he will serve you something special! Some of these will feel like they should break the game wide open, but you'll need every edge you can get if you want to pull off an all nighter.

items.description:
You Know: Associations is a fast, competitive card game where every move matters. Match by colour or category, play smart power cards, build strong combinations, and outscore your opponents in a fun and rewarding card association experience. If you enjoy a card game with strategy and satisfying card connect mechanics, You Know: Associations is made for you.

In this multiplayer card game, you take turns matching cards by CATEGORY or COLOUR. It sounds simple, but every round is full of pressure, timing, and powerful combinations. Use Flip, Block, Take 2, Change Category, and Change Category & Take 4 to control the table and create major momentum swings. Whether you love a quick card game or a card connect challenge, this game keeps every round fresh.

FEATURES:
• Multiplayer card game for 4 players
• Easy-to-learn card association rules
• Match by category or colour
• Create smart combinations and chain powerful plays
• Enjoy strategic decisions in every turn
• Use special action cards to flip, block, stack, and change category
• Competitive coin rewards for top players
• Quick matches with strategic depth
• Resume your game if you return shortly after leaving

You Know: Associations combines the instant fun of a classic card game with strategic gameplay and satisfying card connect action. Every hand gives you new combinations to explore. Every round of card association challenges you to think ahead, manage risk, and hold the right cards for the perfect moment. If you like a card game that rewards smart choices, this is the card association game to download.

HOW TO PLAY

Play one card at a time by matching the top card on the discard pile. You can match by category or by colour. If you cannot play, draw a card. Power Cards let you reverse the turn order, skip the next player, or make them draw cards. Special Cards let you change the category or put even more pressure on your opponents.

Stacking adds even more excitement. When a Take 2 or Change Category & Take 4 card is played, the next player can answer with another penalty card instead of drawing. This creates bigger combinations and raises the total until someone cannot continue. That player takes all stacked cards and loses their turn. These high-pressure moments make every card game round more intense and strategic.

Win by playing all your cards or by finishing with the lowest score when the game ends. Base Cards are worth 5 points, Power Cards are worth 20, and Special Cards are worth 50. Strong card association strategy, careful combinations, and smart card connect decisions are the key to victory. Place in the top 2 to earn coins, build your balance, and join more matches.

If you are searching for a card game with card association strategy, clever combinations, and exciting card connect action, You Know: Associations delivers it all. Download now and enjoy a card game that is easy to start, fun to master, and packed with replay value.

Klondike Solitaire is by far the most popular one player card game, it’s simple, fun and addictive to play! Make the right combinations of the cards to complete the game. Clever thinking is required to win the game! Have you got what it takes?

How to Play Klondike Solitaire:

52 cards, 4 suits, 1 goal: Play To Win!

Klondike Solitaire is one of the easiest and most satisfying card games you can play. The classic version of Solitaire uses a single 52 playing cards, all shuffled before 28 cards are then dealt out onto the table in seven piles.

The object of the game is to order all of the cards into the deck’s four suits (diamonds, clubs, hearts, spades) and to do so in ascending order — from ace to king.

The piles are called tableaus and they are laid out on the table from left to right:

Single card
Two cards
Three cards
Four cards
Five cards
Six cards
Seven cards

The bottom card in each tableau is face-up and the remaining 24 cards (those not dealt out) remain in a single pile called the stock.

Once all the cards are laid out, you then move individual cards from the stock to make your four suited piles. Simply drag cards and move them to the table you wish to place them in.

Klondike Solitaire Card Game rules are very similar to the rules of all other Solitaire variants. If you like Spider Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, Freecell Solitaire, Tripeaks Solitaire or Bowling Solitaire you're going to love to play the Klondike Solitaire Card Game!

Swipe your screen to drag the cards wherever you like.

If you place a small card on top of a larger one, the larger card may shrink. Pay close attention to any size changes and combine them carefully.

items.description:
Three hearts, one infinite canvas, together we illuminate a starry night.

Dear Van Gogh is an interactive journey through the life, art, and inner world of Vincent van Gogh. Travel inside his paintings to witness his earliest uncertainties, his Paris awakening, and the fragile beauty of his final years. Discover and feel the weight of a life lived, and the invisible hands that held it together. 

From the award-winning creators of Journey, join a global community and play through an unforgettable experience of empathy, connection, and art.

A Story Most People Have Never Heard
Everyone knows the legend of Van Gogh. Few know the full story.

At the heart of Van Gogh’s life was a decades-long exchange of letters with his brother, Theo, filled with doubt, wonder, and unfailing devotion that made Van Gogh’s art possible in the first place. Now you can discover that bond firsthand. Guided by Johanna, Theo’s wife and the quiet force who carried Vincent’s legacy forward, you will piece together the story behind the paintings and discover that what we call genius was also, and always, an act of love.

Dear Van Gogh is their story, as much as his. 

Art You Can Walk Through
Explore beautiful, playable environments made from Van Gogh's best known paintings, from sunlit fields in the Netherlands to the glowing night skies that only he could imagine. Each and every landscape is a work of art in motion, rendered in his bold, expressive brushstroke style and alive with the emotion he poured into every canvas.

Paint the World with Others
Just as Van Gogh was never truly alone in his creative journey, neither are you. Use Sky’s signature brushstroke mechanic to collaborate with other players, bringing color and light back to the world together. Because some things are simply more beautiful when shared.

Return to the Real World, Evolved
At the end of the experience, pause and look back at what you experienced. You’re welcome to reflect on and share what you observed and what moved you. Dear Van Gogh in Sky is more than just a game, it is an invitation to see one of history’s greatest artists in a new light, and question everything you thought you knew about the story behind the art.

Winner of:

-Mobile Game of the Year (Apple)
-Outstanding Design and Innovation (Apple)
-Most users in a concert-themed virtual world (Guinness World Record)
-Mobile Game of the Year (SXSW)
-Best Visual Design: Aesthetic (Webby)
-Best Gameplay & People's Choice (Games for Change Awards)
-Audience Award (Game Developers Choice Award)
-Best Indie Game ( Tap Tap Game Awards)

items.description:
Do you remember when you were small, your grandmother or grandfather always were doing brain teasers: crosswords, quizzes, trivia, and sudoku? All these educational games for adults and almost all of us thought it was boring and they were only doing it because there is nothing else to do. That is not the case. They were doing brain training. Our brain is like our body is needed to be trained and looked after. You won’t have the same ease of remembering something in your 70s, unfortunately. To keep your brain sharp, you need to practice, and the best practice is when you don’t get bored. You are playing a game, and the brain thinks that you are relaxing, but you are actually training. Check your general knowledge while playing our game. We have questions on every topic: history, science, even vexillology.

So how does our game work? As you expected from a logic puzzle game. You have questions, and you need to answer them. We designed a new style for quizzes. The main question is located right in the center, and there are two circles. One is for hint questions and another for answers. All you need to do is to match them. So it is a quiz game for adults with a puzzle element that looks like trivia. For each correct answer, you will get points. Ingeniously, isn’t it? Each card with a question gives you three tries. After that, you will lose all bonuses you’ve got while doing this card. Our game’s puzzles consist of interesting facts, some of them you know, some of them you will need to recollect. Don't worry we'll test your knowledge with a few mind games here and there.

We have loads and loads of puzzles and questions

History will help you not to make the same mistakes twice
•  Math to count faster
•  Geography, you will become a walking globe
•  Some science to keep you up-to-date
•  Linguistic to enrich your active vocabulary
•  Musical: sometimes you just need to have fun!

Do you want to improve your memory without studying hard like you have an exam tomorrow? Our offline trivia game for adults will help you with that! Different topics, tricky questions, interesting facts you didn’t know. Outsmart your brain! It is just a game and another way to relax what your subconscious will think. No negative association, so it would be easier to enjoy your everyday brain training routine. Instead of getting grumpy and irritated, you will gain new knowledge!

items.description:
Welcome to Buzzy Party — The Ultimate Buzzer & Party Games Hub! 

Turn your phone into a real-time game show buzzer and the life of the party! Buzzy Party is the best collection of group games for friends, family, and game nights. Whether you love fast-paced buzzer trivia, social deduction, drawing challenges, or hilarious voice mimic battles, Buzzy Party has both offline local games and online multiplayer modes. There is something for everyone!

OFFLINE GAMES (Play locally on one device):
- Mafia: The classic game of deception and social deduction.
- Spy / Imposter: Find the spy before they figure out the secret word!
- Who Am I: Ask questions to guess the character assigned to you.
- Pass the Bomb: Answer quickly before the bomb explodes!
- Sing It Reversed: Sing songs backwards for hilarious results.
- Classic Buzzer: Turn your phone into a fast-paced trivia buzzer.

ONLINE GAMES (Multiplayer across multiple devices):
- Voice Mimic: Listen to hilarious sounds, mimic them into your mic, and battle for the best score!
- Draw & Guess: Draw a secret word while others race to guess it.
- Spy / Imposter: Play the hit deception game online with friends.
- Who Am I: Guess your character in online multiplayer rooms.
- Stop Complete: Race to write words starting with a random letter.
- Guess The Code: Crack the 3-digit secret code.
- Higher or Lower: Guess your number before the others do.
- Points Mode (Sporcle): Answer correctly within the time limit to rack up points.
- Classic Mode: One host controls the buzzer trivia game.
- Rondo Mode: The host rotates every round!
- Team Mode: Group up into teams and compete against each other.

KEY FEATURES
* Unique audio and voice party games like Voice Mimic and real-time Buzzers.
* Create custom trivia packs or play built-in questions.
* Perfect for 3 to 12+ players.
* The ultimate alternative to traditional board games.

Download Buzzy Party now and make your next game night unforgettable!

items.description:
Do you love playing with slime and taking care of cute virtual pets? Now you can enjoy both loves in a single game! Meet Bruno the Super Slime Pet, your new cute, adorable friend!


From Dramaton, the creators of the famous DIY, ASMR 3D coloring games Super Slime Simulator™, Squishy Magic™, and Go! Dolliz™, comes Bruno - My Super Slime Pet, a first of its kind virtual pet simulation game which combines the fun, relaxing creativity of Super Slime Simulator™ with the joy of virtual pet games.  If you like slime DIY and ASMR, making 3D virtual toys, playing simulation games and taking care of virtual pets, you are going to love this new slime pet simulation game! 


Your Super Slime Pet needs lots of love and attention to help it grow up and shine! Take care of your slimy pet friend, play with it, and love it to make it the happiest, most beautiful slime pet in the world! make sure your cute pet is always happy and smiling, but never hungry, sleepy, dirty or bored.




Bruno loves to eat! Feed your hungry slime buddy with tons of delicious snacks and yummies you can buy in the app’s food store: cakes, candy, fruits, pizza, burgers, ice-cream and many more! Discover what your pet likes to eat by its funny reactions! 
Give your pet a slimy bubble bath to keep it shiny and clean!
Enjoy your pet’s funny cute reactions when you pet it, cuddle it, poke it and squish it! So satisfying! 
Put your pet to sleep when it is tired and wake it up in the morning for a new fun day of slime adventures!
Customize your slime friend and give it new cool and cute looks by choosing new slime types for it, coloring it with different slime colors and decorating it with cool, funny slime decorations - just like in a slime DIY game! Each slime boasts a unique texture, sound and behavior, producing a unique ASMR satisfying sensation.
Relieve your stress and discover the relaxing, satisfying ASMR experience of playing with your slime pet: stretch your pet, squish it, knead it, pop it and enjoy your pet’s funny adorable reactions and voices.
Grow your pet! By playing with your pet and taking care of it, your new buddy will advance in levels to unlock new items, food and slime add-ins.


The more you play with your slime pet, cuddle it, pamper it and take care for it, the more coins you earn to unlock new features and items that you can use to treat your pet and give it funny, adorable new looks: new slime types, colors, awesome decorations, and tasty food to feed your pet with. 




Download Bruno - My Super Slime Pet now and discover a world of fun and creative adventures with your virtual pet friend.

Meet Clumsy Ninja, the most hapless ninja ever to grace a touchscreen!

Train him, throw him, tickle him, and even tie balloons to him. Everything you do will make Clumsy Ninja more skillful, and help him find his missing friend, Kira.

Train your ninja to learn new tricks and super-special Ninja Moves! Impress his sensei and earn new Ninja Belts on your way to find Kira, or just have fun with over 70 unique interactive items, including trampolines, punch bags, ball guns, a chicken, and… a squirrel!

ADVENTURE TIME
You and your ninja will travel to new locations, play new games, meet new characters, complete quests, and unlock fun new items to play with. How many will you discover?

CUSTOMIZE
Customize Clumsy Ninja’s suits, belts, and headbands to match your style. Take photos of your ninja’s craziest stunts. Keep your eyes peeled: there are many surprises waiting for you!

UNFORGETTABLE MOMENTS
Clumsy Ninja is a living virtual friend who thinks and acts with real intelligence - and a lot of clumsiness! You’ll experience unique moments with your ninja and his companions every time you play!

FIRST ON TOUCH DEVICES!
Clumsy Ninja is the first game on touch devices to ever use the EUPHORIA simulation technology – producing the most believable character you've ever seen.

items.description:
It’s time to experience the magic of Harry Potter games like never before! Prepare to cast spells, outsmart challenges, and celebrate the wonder of the wizarding world to solve incredible magical Match-3 puzzles from your mobile device! Prove your Match-3 skills by beating levels to unlock new spells to aid your quest to conquer difficult Match-3 puzzles in this Harry Potter game. Upgrade your spells as you prepare for the magically mischievous Match-3 challenges ahead in these free puzzle games.

As you progress in your Match-3 adventure, relive classic moments from the films featuring your favourite wizarding world characters from the Harry Potter films, including Harry, Ron, and Hermione toppling a troll, Fred & George playing pranks, and Hagrid taking care of his magical creatures at Hogwarts! Learn more about the wonders of the wizarding world as you collect magical creatures to aid your Match-3 puzzle solving, this is the best matching game for a Harry Potter fan! Get ready to ‘swish and flick’ your way into a magical journey of your own with this whimsical Match-3 game! This matching game for adults blends strategy, nostalgia, and community into one unforgettable journey.

o Daily Mini-Games: It's more than puzzles! Play different daily activities like fun mini-games: Find the Hidden Object and more matching games for adults.

o Unlock and Upgrade Spells: Use Spells, like Wingardium Leviosa and more, to obliterate obstacles and remove hazards to beat Match-3 puzzles.

o Celebrate the Magic of Harry Potter: Solve new Match-3 games while reliving memorable scenes and sounds from the Harry Potter stories in this strategy game filled with top rated puzzles. Along the way, the Daily Prophet will keep you up-to-date with Harry and his epic journey at Hogwarts.

o Win Rewards: Complete daily missions and limited time events to unlock exclusive event chests filled with power-ups, gold and more collectable rewards to help you with your puzzle mastery

o Play In Clubs: Unite with your clubs to climb the leaderboard and build your legacy. Taste sweet victory when you work with your clubmates to win collaborative challenges like Club Challenge and Battle of Hogwarts, where you must awaken your competitive side and defeat dark foes like Bellatrix, Nagini and more!

o Events Galore: Enjoy daily events! You’ll never get bored when playing fun free games like Duelling, Broom Race and more awesome Match-3 games! These free match 3 games each feature different challenges.

o Unlock Magical Creatures: Amass a glorious collection of marvelous wizarding world creatures to aid in solving challenging Match-3 puzzles and level up your tile-match mastery. Each Magical Creature has unique skills and benefits to assist you in solving challenging and fun free games.

o Customize Your Avatar: Join your favourite Hogwarts house, choose your wand and customize your avatar with unique hairstyles and accessories to stand out in your puzzle solving journey through magical Harry Potter moments!

items.description:
It's game time! Play games instantly on Netflix with the Netflix Game Controller. No gadgets or gizmos needed: Once you install this mobile app, you can use your phone or tablet as a controller to play games on TV, or through your computer browser by visiting Netflix.com. Swipe, tap, type, draw and steer right from your phone.

Once you're set up, the party starts. Plan a group game night to enjoy multiplayer party games with friends and family, or dive into brain-teasing puzzle games and solo adventures. Whether you're relaxing on the couch or taking a break at your desk (we won't tell your boss), you'll have a whole world of games at your fingertips.

Let the fun begin! A few games to try on your TV or computer today:

OVERCOOKED! ALL YOU CAN EAT
Team up with friends as you rush to slice, stir and serve your way through an endless stream of orders. Can you keep your cool in the kitchen?

PICTIONARY: GAME NIGHT
Draw 'til you drop — or one of your friends guesses what you're sketching — in this hilarious and fast-paced spin on the classic group game.

LEGO PARTY!
Play minigames and hunt for gold together through Challenge Zones in this BAFTA award-winning family game. Dodge dragons and flying roast turkeys!

items.description:
YOU NEED THE HITSTER CARD GAME TO USE THIS APP.


Create an instant party with HITSTER, the music card game of the century!

Listen to over 100 years of amazing hits, take turns arranging them in chronological order on your music timeline and create your trip down memory lane. The first player to collect 10 hits is the winner.

With more than 300 of the greatest hits from the last 100 years, HITSTER is the perfect game for an evening with lots of laughing, singing, dancing and sharing memories. Simply open the box, scan a song card with this HITSTER app and let the music do the rest to create an instant party. So what are you waiting for? Invite your friends to have fun together and see who is crowned the HITSTER.

Game characteristics:

- Everybody is invited for the HITSTER party! Super easy rules and no game set-up gets the party started in no-time. Simply scan a card with the free Hitster app and the music starts playing automatically in Spotify, isn't that cool?

- HITSTER is the music game in which you don’t have to be a music expert. Simply guess if a song was released before or after other songs in your music timeline. The futher you are in building your timeline the more challenging it becomes. Your chances of winning increases if you can also name the artists and song titles.

- Are you craving to show of your music knowledge? Play HITSTER with the Pro rules or even Expert rules in which you have to know the exact year, artist and song title.

- Fancy a less competitive trip down memory lane? Then HITSTER can also be played as one team or by yourself.

GET THE PARTY STARTED!

HITSTER requires a mobile phone with an internet connection. For the best experience, use the free HITSTER app and Spotify. Visit www.hitstergame.com for device compatibility.

For the latest Hitster news, updates, and competitions, follow us on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook @hitsterparty.

• The Wall-Slide: Automatically cling to the edges of rigid neon structures and slide vertically at blistering speeds. Follow the bright white guide rails to trace the optimal path through lethal sectors.

Listen closely to the aggressive Phonk, techno, and EDM soundtracks—every single grid obstacle is mathematically mapped to the BGM. Every stage features 3 highly-coveted secret gold coins hidden deep inside dangerous detours. You have the tactical freedom to leave the guide rails and explore space, but the penalty for greed remains instant death.

KEY FEATURES:
• Pure One-Tap Control: Minimalist mechanics combined with punishing, rewarding level design.
• Flawless Beat Synchronization: Every directional change and wall snap locks perfectly onto the music track.

Easy to control, brutal to clear. Will you follow the safe guide rails to the exit, or will you crash and rage quit at 99% chasing the secret coins?

Download Snap Glide: Rhythm Dash for free now. Ride the wall, embrace the stress, and own the beat!

Every song streams from Apple Music. Without a subscription you hear Apple's 30-second preview of each track; with one you hear the full song. Nothing is downloaded.

You get one tenth of a second of a song. Name it.

Can't? Take half a second. Then two. Then eight. Then fifteen. Five chances, and the longer you need, the less it counts.

A CATALOGUE THAT KEEPS GOING
Twenty-three genres and five difficulties, from the songs everyone knows to the ones only you do. Finish a run and the next round moves up a level.

PARTY
Host a room and share the code. Up to ten phones hear the same clip at the same moment; the fastest right answer scores the most. Joining is free for everyone.

YOUR PROFILE
Sign in with Apple or Google. Your picture and your stats follow you between phones, and you can delete everything from the Profile screen whenever you like.

ANY ARTIST, NOT JUST OURS (PREMIUM)
Search for anyone on Apple Music, your favourite band, a local act, someone with four listeners, and play their entire catalogue. Difficulty becomes catalogue depth: Easy is their best known, Impossible is the track nobody streams.

PREMIUM
One purchase, nothing renews: no ad breaks ever, host parties, one-artist mode. Free play shows one short ad after every five rounds.

BUILT TO LOOK GOOD
A stage light you can switch on, and a win sequence worth getting right.

Twisty Arrow: Bow Game is an addictive and exhilarating game that challenges players to test their precision and reflexes. With its simple yet engaging gameplay, the game is suitable for players of all ages. The objective is to shoot arrows at a spinning circle target, aiming to hit the bullseye without touching the other arrows. As the circle twists and spins, the challenge intensifies, requiring players to strategize and improve their accuracy with each shot.

Players must tap their screens to release the arrows, carefully timing their shots to achieve the perfect aim. With each level, the difficulty increases as the spinning wheel rotates in different directions and at varying speeds. The game offers over 100 levels to conquer, with new levels added weekly to keep players engaged.

Featuring a quick reflex twitchy tap style gameplay, Twisty Arrow: Bow Game provides an immersive experience that keeps players on the edge of their seats. The game's funky and upbeat soundtrack adds to the overall enjoyment, creating a vibrant and lively atmosphere.

items.description:
New Dimension Rhythm Game - Experience sound and story unlike ever before.

"A harmony of Light awaits you in a lost world of musical Conflict."

In a world of white, and surrounded by “memory”, two girls awaken under glass-filled skies.

Arcaea is a mobile rhythm game for both experienced and new rhythm game players alike, blending novel gameplay, immersive sound, and a powerful story of wonder and heartache. Experience gameplay that reflects the story’s emotions and events—and progress to unlock more of this unfurling narrative.
Challenging trials can be discovered through play, higher difficulties can be unlocked, and a real-time online mode is available to face off against other players.

Arcaea does not require an internet connection for play, and is fully playable both on smartphones and tablets. On install the game includes a large library of free playable songs, and more can be made available by acquiring additional songs and content packs.

==Features==
- A high difficulty ceiling - experience personal growth as you develop skills in arcade-style progression
- Over 350 songs from more than 200 artists famous across other games
- 3 rhythm difficulty levels for every song
- An expanding music library through regular content updates
- Collaborations with other beloved rhythm games
- Online friends and scoreboards
- Real-time online multiplayer
- A Course Mode that tests endurance through gauntlets of songs
- A rich Main Story that features two protagonist’s perspectives across a powerful journey
- Additional Side and Short Stories of varying styles and perspectives featuring the game’s characters that build upon the world of Arcaea
- A vast array of original characters and guest characters from collaborations to accompany you, level up, and alter your play through many game-changing skills
- Stunning, never-before-seen connections to storylines via gameplay, challenging the very paradigm of play

==Story==
Two girls find themselves in a colorless world full of memory, and with no memory of themselves. Each alone, they set out into places often beautiful, and just as often dangerous.

Arcaea’s story is interwoven throughout Main, Side, and Short stories which each focus on individual, playable characters. While separate, they all share the same space: the world of Arcaea. Their reactions to it, and its reactions to them, form an ever-shifting narrative of mystery, sorrow, and bliss. As they explore this heavenly place, follow their steps down paths of glass and grief.
---

CLIMB THE CHAMPIONSHIP LEAGUES

Team up with racers around the world in a Club. Go head to head with rival clubs in Club Clash, capture ranked positions in best-of-three showdowns, rack up Club Points, and share huge team rewards.

COLLECT CARDS IN SEASONAL COLLECTIONS
Open packs, fill themed albums, and complete Collections for exclusive prizes. Turn duplicate cards into Stars, spend them in the Star Shop, and finish every album in a season to unlock the ultimate reward.

UPGRADE ELITE GEAR
Kit out your drivers with powerful racing gear after every win. Collect gear shards and coupons to unlock rare equipment and level up every piece for the ultimate edge on the track.

UNLOCK THE SEASON PASS & OFFERS
Climb the Season Pass, chase rotating driver banners, and grab limited-time deals that keep every season fresh. There is always a new reward to race for.

items.short_description: ► IT’S A SMASH HIT GAME! The pixelated apocalypse is here, and all that stands between humanity and the forces of destruction is you and your truck…
items.description:
► IT’S A SMASH HIT GAME!

The pixelated apocalypse is here, and all that stands between humanity and the forces of destruction is you and your truck. So climb up to the cab, put your foot to the floor, and race straight for the action in this wildly entertaining demolition game where the only way to win is to hit the giant monsters head-on with all you've got. Then do it again, and again, and again…

◾Start the demolition derby: It's a one-way street headed straight for the monsters, pick your trajectory, hit the ramp and crash straight into the enemy, trying to cause maximum destruction.

◾Keep chipping away: Even the perfect crash isn't going to bring these giant monsters down first time, so chip away at them with multiple attacks until they finally crumble.

◾Study all angles: This is an all-action game, but it pays to use a little strategy if you want to destroy the monsters in the fewest number of moves. Judge the angle and velocity of your truck to maximize damage from each crash and try to bring your enemy tumbling down by hitting their support.

◾They won't go down without a fight: Monsters aren't just going to stand there while you keep ramming into them. Get ready to dodge a whole arsenal of fireballs, spikes on the road, and tossed bombs.

◾So hit them where it hurts: If you want to make your life easier, aim your first assaults at the monster's power source. That way you'll have less to deal with on the road to destruction.

◾And you've got something up your sleeve too: Each time you deal damage to a monster, you gain cogs, which you can spend on augmentations – including rocket launchers, giant bombs, or a size increase for your vehicle – or boosters to increase your armor, power, or bonus for the next crash.

◾Where did they come from and how did they get so big? The game has 52 different animated giant monsters to demolish, from dinosaurs to superheroes to horror legends to ancient myths. Each has their particular powers and weak points, so you'll have to adapt your smash tactics for every level to make progress in the game.

◾Fight the monsters with monster trucks: As you advance in the game, you'll be able to upgrade your pickup for even greater demolition damage, and eventually move on to bigger and better vehicles, including a police car and a full-size semi-truck.

◾Lovely views, shame about the weather: There are eight unique and beautiful locations in the game, from city high-rises to snowy mountain peaks and from abandoned parking lots to outer space, so be sure to enjoy the view while you're there. Unfortunately, you'll also have to deal with the local conditions, which include tornadoes, meteorites and lightning storms.

► KEEP IN TRUCKING 

Looking for an original action adventure with simple but addictive gameplay and increasingly challenging opponents? Ready to demolish an awesome range of massive monsters block by block? Then download Monster Demolition now, set your GPS to Destroy and hit the highway!

items.description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！
Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
Deep strategy, but easy to jump in
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
Progress Without the Grind
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
Unique avatars, without looking the same
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

items.description:
► KING OF THE CASTLE

Well technically it’s a tower, but still. It’s yours, as long as you can keep the zombies away from it in this tower defense strategy game. It appears the zombie apocalypse is upon us based on how many of them are roaming the streets, so keep your gun nearby as you work to build your tower and keep it moving despite the waves of zombies.

► CONSTRUCT AND DEFEND

To build your tower, you’ll need to collect different blocks as you travel, which you can then assemble to form your fortress. Within each of the levels you can add different weapons that will help keep you safe and on the go despite the masses of zombies that are trying to get in to eat your brains. Be careful, once your defenses are breached, you’re as good as dead so keep building and moving!

●  Ready, aim, fire – It’s a zombie tsunami! This RPG shooter will keep you busy blasting zombies as you work to build and protect your mobile castle. Wage war on the undead to avoid becoming one with them. Collect new and exciting weapons along the way, and make sure you upgrade them so that your shooter skills remain top notch.

●  Strategize – Use strategy to plow through your enemies as you roam in search of blocks to add to your tower. While there may be a lot of idle game play and zombie shooting, you will need to plan ahead and think about how and where you want to add weapons and more to your fortress. You’ll need all the guns and protection you can find as you advance through the levels and encounter more and more enemies!

●  Level up – Progress through levels in this tower defense RPG, and gain access to more exciting upgrades, weapons, tower parts, and more! The Earth is your oyster if you can remain a survivor and avoid becoming zombified, so fight for your life and keep exploring.

●  So lively – The graphics, not the zombies. Dive into this world of vibrant and cute characters and delightful animations that really bring everything to life. Who knew fighting off zombie waves could be so adorable? Even as you work to come up with the winning strategy you’ll be able to relax and have some fun thanks to the chill vibes.
 
► LAND OF THE LIVING DEAD

So come on then, survivor, build your tower and wage war on the zombies in this fun and engaging strategy shooter game! Use your tower to travel across the lands as you explore and take out enemies, and have fun customizing all the different levels with neat guns and other weapons that will help you in your fight against the undead. 

Download Tower Destiny Survive today to test your survival skills now!

items.description:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.

▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!

Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.
 
Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.
 
Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!
 
Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.
 
Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.
 
Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!
 
RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/riseofkingdomsgame/

items.description:
Build a life. Then build a legacy.

Everlife 2 is a generational life simulator about the person you want to become and every obstacle that gets in your way. Take control from birth to old age, one season at a time. Work on your grades. Make the wrong friend. Fall for someone unavailable. Take a job because rent is due. Build a life that is yours, even when it goes off the rails.

EVERY LIFE LEAVES SOMETHING BEHIND
When your character dies, read their obituary and choose what comes next. Start over, resurrect, or continue through the family tree, inheriting property, money, relationships, family history, and unfinished consequences.

CREATE SOMEONE. SEE WHO THEY BECOME.
Choose appearance, age, hometown, birthday, birth sign, family, backstory, traits, and physical conditions. The person you create shapes the people, opportunities, and problems they encounter. New traits can emerge through play, turning them into a nurturing parent, heartbreaker, workaholic, or something worse.

GROW UP YOUR WAY
Live through school with grades, cliques, clubs, friendships, family drama, and teen dating. Apply to college, choose housing and electives, join Greek life, study abroad, or take a summer job. Every stage opens new paths and opportunities.

MAKE A LIVING
Build a resume, search a changing job board, face interviews, and climb ten ranks across 35 career paths and 350 jobs. Education, skill, experience, and performance all matter. Get promoted, get fired, switch fields, earn a bonus, take a pay cut, or retire with a work history that reads like a life.

TURN TALENT INTO SOMETHING REAL
Develop more than 20 skills, then use them on projects with budgets, time commitments, difficulty, and real odds of failure. Write a novel, record an album, film a feature, build an app, launch a fashion line, restore a home, grow an exotic garden, or create a personal robot.

LOVE, FIGHT, FORGIVE, REPEAT
Make friends who last beyond the card that introduced them. Date, move in, propose, marry, cheat, divorce, reconcile, become estranged, or let an ex return with excellent timing and terrible intentions. Relationships shape future stories, household life, and the branches of your family tree.

RAISE A FAMILY
Plan a pregnancy, pursue donor IVF or surrogacy, adopt, or decide parenthood is not for this life. Every child has relationships and wellbeing of their own. Set rules, support them through school, navigate teen phases, and watch years of parenting shape the adult they become.

MAKE A HOME IN A WORLD THAT MOVES
Buy, build, sell, and flip property in a changing housing market. Add a studio, gym, nursery, or greenhouse, then live with lot traits that can make a home cozy, moldy, infested, or haunted. Buy vehicles whose condition affects their value. Adopt pets with their own ages, personalities, bonds, and wellbeing. Take vacations or move towns.

FACE THE HARD YEARS
Health problems can begin as symptoms before a diagnosis. Visit the doctor, weigh treatments that demand money, time, or follow-up care, and live with the consequences. Injuries, mental health struggles, cravings, relationship damage, and recovery can reshape a life.

MORE THAN 6,000 CARDS. OVER A MILLION WORDS.
Thousands of handwritten scenarios, actions, conversations, projects, and life moments span school, romance, work, family, health, housing, crime, fame, and the supernatural. Pursue Goals, collect Discoveries, unlock Achievements, and watch two lives that began in the same town end with almost nothing in common.

PLAY ON YOUR TERMS
Adjust the speed, skip a season or a year, and play offline. Everlife 2 is free to download, requires no account, and has no waiting timers or purchasable currencies.

One life is only the beginning.

How will you live your Everlife?

versions.changelog:
Patch 1.0.3

Changes
• Added household selection when moving, including the family members who accompany each person.
• Residents now ask before moving a spouse and dependent family into your own household, but not while you live in your childhood home.
• Siblings now leave the childhood home between ages 18 and 20. Invited roommates no longer move out randomly.
• Added Timed Cards settings: Default (8 seconds), Slower (12 seconds), and Slowest (16 seconds).
• Newly applied hair dye now lasts five in-game years, remaining at full color for the first half before gradually fading.
• Added a compact Action Menu category view. Tap Categories again to switch between detailed and compact layouts.
• Reorganized Care, Homes, and Vehicles, added useful shortcuts, and clarified locked family planning options.
• Improved the Move screen with town names and icons, selection highlights, and property keep/sell labels.
• Improved menu layouts, transitions, character labels, and translations.
• Reduced repeated names and relationship labels on follow-up cards.
• Owned expansions now appear in My Collection instead of the purchase list. Improved pack descriptions, feature cards, and shop presentation.
• Improved Sell Assets with clearer names, prices, Wealth totals, and controls.
• Start a new life now ends your current life and opens succession to continue your family or start a new dynasty.
• Improved the in-game bug report form and submission feedback.
• Improved performance.
• Improved save speed.

Fixes
• Fixed household marriage and move-in cards not swiping, using incorrect family labels, or showing stale text after loading.
• Fixed inconsistent relationship shortcuts and missing Find love, Friends, Family, and pet-shopping options.
• Fixed household members disappearing from other relationship sections and Prank Call opening the wrong picker.
• Fixed overlapping icons and broken text wrapping in Sell Assets.
• Fixed a mobile-build issue that could announce a grandchild without adding them to the family.
• Fixed first-trimester events appearing before the pregnancy reveal.
• Fixed pregnancy and cheating reactions targeting the wrong partner, and birth dialogue incorrectly claiming you rejected the baby.
• Fixed breaking up with an engaged partner failing to find an outcome.
• Fixed divorce events involving deceased parents or couples who were no longer married.
• Fixed incorrect names and pronouns in family, relationship, and pet text, and childhood events displaying adult text.
• Fixed graduate-only jobs and moving options appearing for ineligible young characters.
• Fixed incorrect age restrictions, duplicate entries, and empty categories in the Action Menu.
• Fixed suggested actions confirming the wrong action or person after refreshing.
• Fixed swipes submitting an answer before release or after returning the card to the center.
• Fixed nightclub results appearing late and Have a drink incorrectly requiring Life of Crime.
• Fixed being unable to keep searching after rejecting a sire, and new sire encounters appearing after becoming a vampire.
• Fixed being unable to reapply to college after dropping out, and dorm events continuing after leaving college.
• Fixed mould effects from hidden homes and hidden childhood homes becoming active again after loading.
• Fixed retirement residences being inherited by successors.
• Fixed Assign chores targeting the wrong family member.
• Fixed automatic speeding encounters repeating too frequently.
• Fixed Reduce Motion blocking essential animations, including the death screen and obituary Continue button.
• Fixed rabbits displaying alpaca pictures.
• Fixed staff and personal settings carrying into a successor's life.
• Fixed owned expansions becoming locked after loading older saves. Ownership checks now retry and preserve existing unlocks offline.
• Fixed repeated checkout attempts while an expansion purchase was still pending.

items.description:
A city is swallowed by the tides, and Chimera emerge from the abyss—humanity’s last hope rests in the hands of every Titan Commander.
Enter your Titan and rush to the front lines. This is a struggle for survival in a brutal mech-dominated war. Rescue survivors, rebuild the last shelter, and defend for your lives. As the tides rise, the moment of attack has arrived—fight for humanity’s survival!

Immersive Story | Commander’s Choice in the Apocalypse
Attacks on Titans have caused countless rescue missions. This is not a simple robot game; it’s a test of decision-making. Will you delve into the Chimera hives, risking everything to save more survivors? Or will you save your forces to defend your shelters? Every decision you make will rewrite history. The fate of your shelter, your comrades, and the future of humanity rests in your hands. There are no right answers, only the consequences you must bear.

Build Your Own Mech | Weapons of War
Customize your mech to match your style, from the head to the torso to the weapon attachments. There are dozens of combinations that can be used across different battlefields, such as melee combat, primal rush, firepower suppression, and targeted airstrikes. Test your combinations in real combat to unlock rare components used for modifications, and rush through the smoke of battle to take on stronger enemies. Build a unique mech to slay the Chimera—it’s not just a weapon, it’s the key to your survival.

Recruit Elite Commanders | Heroes Rally in Desperate Situations
Encounter Commanders with exceptional skills in the wasteland. Each Commander has unique passive skills + active tactical skills. Combine different Commanders and Titans to trigger synergy bonuses. Strategically combine skills and master battle mechanics to control fights and achieve victory against overwhelming odds. Make your squad invincible against rush attacks, repelling wave after wave of Chimera.

Manage your Shelter | A Fortress of Hope in the Apocalypse
Build and upgrade hydro farms, desalination plants, refineries, power plants, and more. Continuously supply frontline mechs with power and minerals. Assign survivors to manage production, research, or defense missions—each role is critical for survival. Upgrade your shelter’s defenses to unlock more roles. Your shelter is a beacon of hope in the apocalypse.

Front Line Battles | Endless Exploration
Pilot your Titan, traversing half-submerged skyscrapers and abandoned subway tunnels, to regain control of the world. Every battlefield is filled with massive changes. The Chimera are attacking, so grab your weapons and prepare for mecha domination! Stay alert and quickly plan battle strategies. Positioning and decisive use of Commander Skills are critical to slaying Chimera and preventing their rampage.

Alliance Cooperation | Coordinated Defense
Join or create an Alliance to share resources, exchange blueprints, and build frontline outposts. Beware of Chimera rush attacks! Work together to search for the origins of the Titans. Rare resources and powerful Chimera leaders require coordinated mech deployments from multiple Commanders. The higher the risk, the greater the reward! Unlock the Alliance tech tree, climb the rankings, and achieve the ultimate glory of “Apocalypse Savior.”

Join now, Commander!
The tides may recede, but we will never retreat.
Download for free and become an apocalyptic hero now!

Forge, Upgrade, and Compete Across the Ages!

Step into an online world where progress never stops. In this competitive multiplayer game, you’ll forge weapons and armor from different civilizations, research new technologies, train pets, and climb the global leaderboard.

Forge Gear Through the Ages

Start in the Stone Age and forge your first weapons and armor in your anvil. Forge your path through history, unlock new eras of technology, and prove your skill in this ever-evolving online game.

Start forging today and see how far your hero can go!

items.description:
Command legendary dragons, forge powerful alliances, and conquer the Seven Kingdoms in the ultimate Game of Thrones strategy game. Build your empire, raise a fearsome dragon army, and wage RTS war across Westeros to claim the Iron Throne. Game of Thrones: Dragonfire is an epic 4X strategy war game where you lead your House through conquest, diplomacy, and dragon warfare in the most immersive medieval fantasy game on mobile.

COLLECT & COMMAND MIGHTY DRAGONS
Hatch, train, and command legendary dragons. Battle with Syrax, Caraxes, Seasmoke, and more. Each dragon possesses unique abilities to turn the tide of tactical warfare. Build an unstoppable dragon army, collect rare species, and evolve them into forces of pure destruction to dominate the skies of Westeros.

WAGE EPIC STRATEGIC WARFARE
Lead your armies in high-stakes PvP war and real time strategy combat. Lay siege to enemy strongholds, defend your castle, and outmaneuver rival Houses in thrilling battles. Whether engaging in PvE campaigns or global clan wars, your mastery of RTS mechanics and cunning strategy will determine who reigns supreme. 

BUILD & UPGRADE YOUR KINGDOM
Master base building as you grow a small stronghold into an unassailable fortress. Manage vital resources to fuel your conquest of Westeros and train elite troops in this thrilling battle game. Effective kingdom management and defensive upgrades are the keys to surviving the brutal politics of the Seven Kingdoms. 

CONQUER THE SEVEN KINGDOMS
Explore a detailed map of Westeros featuring iconic landmarks like the Red Keep, Dragonstone, and Harrenhal. Expand your empire across legendary regions, conquer rival territories, and control the most powerful strongholds in the realm. In this MMO strategy world, every territory claimed brings you closer to the Iron Throne.

DISCOVER EPIC STORYLINES
Step into the official game of the HBO show House of the Dragon, set 172 years before Daenerys Targaryen. Immerse yourself in a narrative-rich campaign where your decisions shape the destiny of the realm. Interact with iconic characters like Rhaenyra Targaryen and Daemon Targaryen in a story filled with the drama, betrayal, and intrigue that defines Game of Thrones.

FORGE MULTIPLAYER ALLIANCES
Join forces with players worldwide in this massive multiplayer strategy MMO. Coordinate grand strategies with your alliance, dominate the world map, and wage war against rival factions. In a land of shifting loyalties, strong diplomacy and coordinated alliance warfare are essential to securing your legacy. 

WHY PLAY GAME OF THRONES: DRAGONFIRE?
• The Definitive GoT Strategy Game: Officially licensed medieval fantasy RPG and war game.
• Deep 4X Gameplay: Explore, expand, exploit and exterminate in a massive world.
• Stunning Visuals: High-fidelity graphics bring the dragons and strongholds of Westeros to life. 
• Live Events: Regular updates featuring new dragons, seasonal events, and storylines. 
• Global PvP: Compete against thousands of strategists in real-time throne battles. 

Download Game of Thrones: Dragonfire now and begin your conquest! The battle for the Seven Kingdoms has begun; Will you command the fire and claim the throne?

An easy-to-play Roguelike shooter combined with thrilling tower defense survival gameplay!

Daytime: Use your resources to upgrade your base, recruit soldiers, and deploy powerful defenses like Machine Gun Towers and EMP Towers to prepare for battle!  
Nighttime: Nearly a hundred mutated zombies and giant bosses storm in—defend your fortress until dawn!

Forget human survivors—this time, you’ll play as a brave duck, unlocking a wide variety of stylish and unique duck skins!  
Every night you survive fuels your base's evolution. Fail? The zombies will quack their way through your defenses!

Skilled agents, machine-gun-wielding baby dragons, and many more super-powered heroes are waiting to join you!

Adapt to the ever-changing battlefield, adjust your strategy on the fly, and experience the endless possibilities of Roguelike combat!  

- Diverse Builds, Strategy Meets Progression!
Heroes, skills, and tower defense mechanics work together to create a wide range of combat builds.  
With gear, gems, and other progression systems outside of battle, you can keep growing stronger and crush endless zombie hordes!  

- Rich Gameplay, Escalating Challenges!
Beyond intense base defense battles, you can also dive into dungeon exploration, Guild Boss fights, and Arena PvP.  
In the face of endless zombie hordes, prove that you are the ultimate survivor!  

Can you quack your way to the very end of the apocalypse?  
Join Duck Survival now—rally your duck squad and dive into fast-paced horde shooting and strategic tower defense battles!

items.description:
Dragon City is a mobile game where players build a floating city, collect and breed over 2,000 unique dragons, and battle other Dragon Masters in real-time PvP combat.

It is one of the most popular fantasy dragon games on mobile, combining city-building, creature collection, deep strategic combat, and social alliance gameplay.

With over 80 million Dragon Masters worldwide and new content every week, Dragon City is the ultimate dragon collecting and battling game for mobile.

DRAGON CITY FEATURES:

▶ BUILD A CITY IN THE DRAGONVERSE
Design, expand, and rule your own floating Dragon City across magical islands:

• Build farms, habitats, and buildings to house your ever-growing dragon collection
• Unlock special structures like the Tree of Life and Guardian Dragon Towers
• Explore the Ancient World and uncover the deepest Dragonverse legends
• Expand across new islands, each with unique environments, challenges, and rewards
• Decorate your city with exclusive skins and items from seasonal events and mini-games
• Manage resources strategically, the bigger your city, the more powerful your dragons become


▶ COLLECT 2,000+ DRAGONS
Dragon City features one of the largest dragon rosters in any mobile game:

• Collect dragons across dozens of elements (Flame, Nature, Legend, Sea, Electric, Ice, and many more)
• Breed dragons together to discover unique hybrid species with combined elemental powers
• Over 1,500 dragon combinations to discover, from common breeds to ultra-rare legendaries
• New legendary dragons join every week through events, battle passes, and special adventure islands
• Feed and evolve your dragons through multiple growth stages, from baby hatchlings into legendary beasts
• Unlock exclusive dragon Skins from seasonal events to customize your favorites
• Complete the Book of Dragons, the ultimate collector's challenge


▶ STRATEGIZE & CONQUER: REAL-TIME PVP COMBAT
Dragon City is built for competitive players who love strategic monster battle gameplay:

• Fight other Dragon Masters in real-time PvP Arenas with teams of up to three dragons
• Master elemental strengths and weaknesses to build the most effective battle lineup
• Collect Orbs to empower your dragons and grow their combat strength with every upgrade
• Climb leaderboards and claim Warrior's Chests packed with rare dragons and exclusive rewards
• Complete Quests and adventure through special islands to unlock one-of-a-kind dragons
• Compete in seasonal PvP tournaments and limited-time events against millions of players worldwide


▶ ALLIANCE & SOCIAL FEATURES
Dragon City is more than a solo adventure, it's a global community of Dragon Masters:

• Build or join Alliances to fight rival Dragon Masters as a team
• Chat with allies, coordinate strategies, and share Alliance Gifts
• Open Alliance Chests to unlock exclusive dragons only available through teamwork
• Trade dragon Orbs with other players in the Trading Hub to strengthen your collection faster
• Connect and compete with over 80 million Dragon Masters across the globe

items.description:
War Pets have arrived in Call of Dragons! Capture ferocious beasts in a vast 3.88m sq km map, and train them up to fight alongside you!
 
【Capture War Pets】
Subdue ferocious beasts and deploy them alongside powerful fantasy armies!

【Train War Pets】
Interact with your War Pet to increase their Affection Level. Strengthen them by feeding them, regenerating them, or inheriting Skills. Your War Pet will be an indespensible member of your forces!

【Summon Behemoths】
Team up with your allies to take on gigantic Behemoths, then summon them in combat to dominate the battlefield!

【Freedom To Fight】
Take advantage of truly 3D terrain to create your strategy, command flying legions to traverse mountains and rivers, and unleash powerful combat skills to lead your allies to victory in huge-scale fantasy warfare!

【An Immersive Fantasy World】
Recruit Elven maidens, mighty Orcs, powerful frost mages, and countless other magical heroes. Journey to the mystical Firefly Tree, the daunting Frozen Spires, and other fantastic wonders, and enjoy a vast fantasy world like nothing you've ever seen before.
 
*****Game Features*****
 
 【Purify War Pets, Then Fight Beside Them】
 Simple-hearted Bears, stubborn Lizards, aloof Rocs, and mischievous Faedrakes– they're all waiting to become your new best friend! Purify them to bring them under your command, then deploy them alongside vast fantasy armies. Train them up to strengthen their powers and turn your magical companion into a devastating weapon!

【Hunt and Tame Behemoths】
The land of Tamaris is infested with Behemoths—giant ancient beasts like Hydras, Thunder Rocs, and mighty and terrifying Dragons. Stand shoulder to shoulder with your allies to bring them to heel, then train them to become your secret weapon. Then, in your hour of need, deploy Behemoths to crush your enemies!

【Heal Units for Free】
Wounded units can be healed automatically without consuming any resources. Wage war, challenge other players, and fight to your heart's content! Enjoy the thrill of the battlefield without worrying about your stockpiles. Your path to conquest begins now!

【Countless Fantastic Creatures】
The land of Tamaris is filled with many fantastic races: noble Elves, mighty Orcs, wily Satyrs, wise Treants, majestic Forest Eagles and otherworldly Celestials. Each of these races can join your forces and lead them to victory. Meanwhile, Hydras, Giant Bears, Thunder Rocs and other terrifying creatures lie in wait...

【Powerful Hero Skills】
Assign mighty heroes to lead your forces, and train them up to use powerful abilities that allow them to turn invisible, charge across the battlefield in an instant, or unleash devastating AoE attacks! Master the battlefield, then strike at a critical moment to turn the tide of battle and claim victory!

【3D Terrain & Flying Legions】
Take advantage of rich and varied 3D terrain to carry out rapid assaults, defend your position, and unleash air raids to crush the enemy with strategy. Deploy flying legions across canyons, deserts, rivers, and mountains to deliver a devastating blow!

【Expand, Exploit, Explore, & Exterminate】
The prosperity of the kingdom is in your hands. Upgrade buildings and technologies, train troops, gather resources, expand your territory, and prove that you are worthy to rule Tamaris!

SUPPORT
If you encounter any issues during the game, you can send us feedback via the in-game Customer Service Center.
Customer Service Email: callofdragons-service@farlightgames.com

items.description:
►GOT BRAINS? 

Everyone’s worst nightmare has come true: things have gone nuclear, and the zombie apocalypse has arrived! With survivors few and far between, you’ll need to navigate between driving back the walking dead, building strongholds and bases, crafting supplies, and just plain survival! This idle simulator has it all, from the thrill of bashing in zombie heads to collecting resources.

►BRAINS OVER BRAWN

Start off by building a base that you can take refuge in, then venture out to take out these zombies, stalker style! Don’t forget about defense though – your survival depends on making friends with the other humans and adding them to your team so that someone always has your back. Together you’ll be able to craft, explore, and kick zombie butt till the cows come home!

Fun Features:

● Zombies Galore: As a lucky survivor, you’ve been thrust into a nightmarish world where the walking dead roam the land in overwhelming numbers. Armed with limited resources and unyielding determination, navigate the treacherous post-apocalyptic landscapes and fend off hordes of undead to both stay alive and defend your base. The sheer volume of zombies to kill ensures that you’ll get to experience both offense and defense in this exciting test of strategy and survival instincts.

● Get Crafty: As you navigate the simulator, you’ll have the chance to collect all sorts of resources that will come in handy for constructing buildings, healing yourself and team members, and driving out the zombie hordes. Thanks to the idle aspect of this game you’ll be able to take some breathers from the chaos and just focus on gathering items and stockpiling resources.

● Explore Some More: The world is your oyster, the only thing keeping you from sitting back to enjoy it are all these zombies! In driving them from their hideouts, you’ll get to explore tons of great locations and neat areas, as well as build various strongholds in them. Different locations offer up different resources too, so keep your eyes peeled for these and more as you explore.

● Great Storyline: This simulator was created with an open-ended storyline that just keeps evolving, meaning there are always fun new locations, and not so fun new zombies that want to eat your brains. Survival doesn’t have to be boring!

►WILL YOU SINK OR SWIM?

With the ability to build and defend strongholds, craft supplies, and form alliances with other survivors, every moment of survival is packed with both excitement and strategy. 

Download Last Stronghold today to dive into this exhilarating idle simulator and see if you’ve got both the brains and the brawn needed to survive the zombie apocalypse and rebuild society!

Only the toughest can make it through – can you?

I Am Bird is an evolution of the immersive experience, setting you free in the skies of a bustling metropolis as a city pigeon. Pedestrians below arrive with different personalities: some are generous crumb-givers, others are busy, easily annoyed, or hostile. Each fly-by changes the rhythm of the street, creating moments of slapstick comedy, aerial chaos, and urban tension.

The concrete jungle becomes an interactive playground. French fries, shiny trinkets, and unsuspecting heads can be pecked, grabbed, or targeted from above. Rooftops, power lines, café tables, and every reaction from the crowd are fully interactive, making each flight unique and alive.

With fully interactive physics, unpredictable crowd behavior, and a mix of humor and mischief, I Am Bird offers a sandbox experience that blends boundless freedom with nasty encounters.

Gameplay features:

Be the Bird – fully immersive perspective of an urban scavenger.

Multiple play styles – beg, steal, annoy, or unleash chaos from above.
Various citizens – humans who can be friendly feeders, angry haters, or oblivious targets.
Sandbox interactivity – drop "gifts," snatch personal items, flap in faces, and manipulate your environment.

Play as a Pigeon In I Am Bird, you live above the chaos, but your world is full of choices. Citizens rush by — some kind, some cruel — each one shaping the story of the feathered menace.

Fashion Queen: Dress Up Game is a game for true fashion lovers. Dress up your model in the best outfits and show them off on the catwalk!

The game starts with you selecting your model, who will be the face of your fashion empire. You will have the opportunity to dress her up in a variety of clothes and accessories, from dresses to shoes to jewelry. You can even design your own dress and see how it looks on your model.

Fashion Queen: Dress Up Game is a game for girls who love Barbie, fashion shows, doll dressing up, make up, fashion design and more.
So what are you waiting for? It's time to start dressing up your model and showing off your fashion style. Download the game now and become the ultimate fashion queen!

versions.changelog:
New This Release

New Raid Auto-Launch
Raids are getting an easier daily launch routine! Starting each day at 1:00 PM (PT), a scheduled Raid will automatically launch for every Alliance—so there’s no need to wait for someone to hit the button or set it up.. Alliances will still choose their preferred Difficulty, but Raids can no longer be launched manually. We’ve also updated the Alliance joining rules: after being in an Alliance for 12 hours, you can jump into any Raid already in progress. Get in, coordinate with your Alliance, and make those daily Raid attacks count!

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue that could cause players to become stuck during the New User Experience on the homepage, preventing access to game options.
Fixed ISO-8’s Equip All resource list so the highest-value tiers appear first.
Fixed the ISO-8  Upgrade All slider so it defaults to the highest upgrade level affordable with the player’s available resources.
Added missing ISO-8 class names to the Upgrade All pop-up.
Fixed an issue where the ISO-8 Upgrade All pop-up remained open after completing a class upgrade.
Fixed a dead-end UI in Danger Room at Difficulty 6 and higher for players without Rental Packs
Fixed an issue where the defeat marker appeared over the wrong character on the Defeat screen.
Fixed the Not on Cooldown filter in Survival Tower.
Fixed an issue where Alliance damage contribution remained unchanged across Trepidation Raid difficulty levels.

items.description:
Who’s in your Justice League? Join your favorite DC Super Heroes and Super-Villains in this action-packed, free fighting game! Assemble a team of Super Hero legends like Batman, Superman, Supergirl, The Flash and Wonder Woman to combat the forces against you. Master new combos and crush opponents in dynamic 3v3 battles. Upgrade your Super Heroes with special powers as you fight your way through the game. Become a champion by collecting gear for your characters and dominating your foes in PvP contests. Every epic battle in this CCG fighting game will define you—join the fight and become the ultimate DC champion!

COLLECT ICONIC DC CHARACTERS
● Choose from a massive selection of DC Super Heroes and Super-Villains in this epic CCG fighting game!
● Featuring classic fan favorites such as Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Supergirl, The Flash, Aquaman and Green Lantern, and astonishing new Villains like The Joker, Brainiac and Harley Quinn from Suicide Squad
● Take control of how your characters look, fight and develop across a variety of game modes!

ACTION PACKED COMBAT
● Unleash epic combos on your opponents using Superman’s heat vision, The Flash’s lightning kick or Harley Quinn’s cupcake bomb!
● Take your battles to the next level—inflict massive damage using your favorite DC characters’ Supermoves
● Earn rewards from each fight to customize your Super Heroes with powerful gear, and collect special characters like Justice League Batman, Mythic Wonder Woman, Multiverse The Flash and much more
● Team up with friends in this fight game and assemble an unstoppable League! Together you can prevent the collection of worlds and defeat the ultimate boss, Brainiac
● Be social—chat with friends, donate hero shards, participate in Raids, and more!

CONSOLE QUALITY STORY
● Injustice 2 continues the story set in motion by the hit 3v3, CCG Super Hero fighting game Injustice: Gods Among Us
● Immerse yourself in cinematics straight from the console—with the Justice League shattered, it is up to you to pick up the story and unite a team
● Experience Injustice 2’s high-quality console graphics on mobile—play with Superman, The Flash, Batman, and many more in high definition 3v3 combat
● Become the fighting champion the world needs—enter a contest of Super Heroes where only the powerful win
● Though killed by Superman, The Joker continues to haunt the lives of all those touched by his madness. By destroying Metropolis, he set the events in motion which made enemies of Superman and Batman. If The Joker were alive to see the chaos he’d created, he would surely be smiling!

FIGHT YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
● Join the contest—enjoy daily challenges and rise up the leaderboard with every fight victory
● Enter the PvP arena and fight players around the world to become a champion
● Unite the likes of The Flash, Supergirl, Batman and more to fight in epic, PvP combat

NEW SYNERGIES, NEW GEAR & NEW CHAMPIONS
● Explore new team synergies—League of Anarchy, Justice League, Multiverse, Suicide Squad, Batman Ninja and Legendary!
● Unlock a new universal gear type—Artifacts can be equipped on any Super Hero to gain bonus stats and unique passive bonuses!
● Champions Arena is here—show off your skilled roster and mastered techniques in the largest fighting competition to date. Champions Arena brings together the best fighters in the game to get exclusive rewards, claim the top, and battle players around the world!

Download this truly epic, free fighting game today and unite YOUR Justice League!

items.description:
► SLOWLY BUT SURELY

Looking for a game with gallons of nitro and adrenaline, tricked out sports cars, crazy crashes, and foot-to-the-floor action? Well, you’d better keep looking, because Vehicle Masters is something a little different – a more relaxing simulator game that offers careful drivers the refined pleasures and simple satisfaction of accurately moving heavy vehicles through tight spaces while avoiding scrapes and collisions. Test your advanced driving skills in an enormous range of different trucks, buses and even excavators in this soothing, enjoyable and surprisingly realistic truck simulator.

► REAL DRIVING

• Realistic steering, acceleration and braking carefully calibrated for all vehicle types.
• Adapt your driving technique to different road conditions and situations.

► YOU CAN’T PARK THERE!

• Gently does it! Follow the steering pointers to guide your vehicle into the green space.
• Missed the mark? Don’t panic, you can always reverse out slowly and try again.
• Feel the satisfaction as you finally get your unwieldy vehicle perfectly parked.

► VEHICLE VARIATION

• Over 20 different cars, trucks and other vehicles to drive in the game.
• Get behind the wheel in pickups, articulated trucks, fire trucks, police cars and even excavators.
• More than 80 items to decorate and customize the interior of your vehicle.

► TRUCKING ALL OVER THE WORLD

• 7 regions in the game with different climate and road conditions.
• 20 unique areas to navigate, from crowded parking lots to twisting mountains roads.
• Keep on trucking and enjoy the gorgeous views as you drive.

► MORE THAN JUST A DRIVER
