items.description:
Land Builder is a puzzle game that lets you dream, a relaxing game that lets you expand your horizons, an adventure game that lets you build the world you want to see.

► AN ENGAGINGLY SIMPLE PUZZLE

A simulator game where you build a whole world piece-by-piece, Land Builder is designed around a simple principle – just place the hexagonal pieces next to any other piece on the board and expand your world the way you want to – but offers hours and hours of construction simulator fun and relaxing entertainment.

•  Place the next piece on the board and rotate it to match the pieces next to it in the way you want, defining the coastlines and urban boundaries on your map.

•  Each piece you place earns you stars, and the as the number of stars increases, you unlock new world-building features such as factories, farms, oil rigs, monuments, leisure facilities and other infrastructure that add further variety to your ever-growing world. 

•  You also earn improvements to different elements of the visual aspects of Land Builder, making the details of towns, countryside and the sea richer, clearer and even more attractive.

► A WORLD-BUILDING MEDITATION

The horizon is endless in Land Builder, and the simple simulator system is designed specifically to make this puzzle adventure relaxing rather than frustrating. 

•  Soothing music, gentle sound effects and attractive graphics all contribute to the game’s anti-stress properties, making playing the game more like a satisfying and absorbing meditation than a challenging and enervating puzzle.

•  There are no wrong answers or false moves in the game, and you can always undo your last move.

•  Whenever you have a few minutes free and just want to relax, you can dive into your own little world and enjoy the serenity and creative satisfaction of Land Builder.

► A PERFECTLY RELAXING ADVENTURE

Land Builder opens up a whole world of possibility that can fire your imagination and boost your creative impulses.

•  Combine elements of countryside, town and sea in any way that you want, building a world of little villages, a series of picturesque islands or a bustling seaside city – it’s entirely up to you how the landscape develops.

•  As you advance through the game and build out the world of your dreams, you also earn bonuses that increase your opportunities to alter and adapt the lands you have already constructed, allowing you to redesign the world you’re building or just smooth out any imperfections.

•  Zoom out to see the whole expanse of the world you’ve constructed or zoom in to see the beauty of each little piece up close.

Looking for a casual puzzle game that’s engaging, relaxing and creative? Download and play Land Builder now and get ready to expand your horizons.

WHAT IS VENUE?
Venue is a free room decorating app for iPhone and iPad where players style realistic interior spaces, complete client projects, and design your room as they imagine it. One of the calmest decorating games on the store, Venue replaces match-3 and energy meters with intuitive drag-and-drop styling, soothing music, and a deep catalog of real-world decor.

WHAT MAKES VENUE DIFFERENT FROM OTHER HOME DESIGN GAMES?
Venue is one of the few home design games with no puzzles, no timers, and no daily play limits. Most popular decorating games lock progress behind match-3 or energy mechanics. Venue is built around the design itself: you spend your time styling, not solving. The catalog feels like a real interior decorating app, with textiles, lighting, and furniture modeled on current interior design trends, placing Venue among the best interior design apps for players who care about realism.

IS VENUE A GOOD GAME FOR ADULTS WHO WANT TO RELAX?
Yes. Venue is built as a calm creative home design game for adults. With soothing music, intuitive controls, and a deep library of dream room ideas, it suits evening wind-down, anxiety-friendly play, or quiet creative time. Many players use Venue the way others use coloring books: a low-stakes outlet for creativity, unlike most pressure-driven design games.

HOW DO YOU PLAY AND PROGRESS IN VENUE?
You receive a client brief, a blank room, and a curated catalog of furniture, lighting, plants, wallpapers, and textiles. Drag pieces into place, mix textures, and submit when happy. Earn rewards, unlock locations, and move through a designer career story. Weekly Limited Series, Pet Events, and the Style Book keep things fresh, setting Venue apart from generic room decoration games.

WHAT KINDS OF ROOMS CAN YOU DESIGN IN VENUE?
Venue covers living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, home offices, outdoor patios, and vacation properties from villas to cabins, penthouses, and cottages, one of the most varied games for house design available. It delivers the kind of range games about designing a house rarely offer.

WHO IS VENUE BUILT FOR?
• Adults looking for interior design games to unwind with after work
• Interior design fans who want home decor play without renovation costs
• Players tired of puzzle mechanics in other house design games
• Casual gamers who enjoy progression without competitive pressure
• iPad and iPhone users who want a polished, touch-first room decorating app

WHY PLAYERS LOVE VENUE
Updated weekly, Venue is a room decor application with content depth rare among make house games. The Daily Top Designs feed showcases community work, and the Style Book unlocks aesthetics from minimalist to maximalist.

FAQ

IS VENUE FREE TO PLAY?
Yes. Venue is free to download. The full design experience is available, and optional in-app purchases unlock premium decor items and cosmetic upgrades.

DOES VENUE HAVE MATCH-3, TIMERS, OR ENERGY?
No. Venue intentionally has none. You can redecorate a single room for as long as you want, take breaks, and return without losing progress, the core promise of these house games.

DOES VENUE WORK ON IPHONE AND IPAD?
Yes. Venue is built for both, with a touch-first interface in portrait and landscape modes, comfortable for longer home design game sessions on a larger display.

Download Venue today and start designing the dreamy rooms you have always imagined, with no pressure and puzzles. Your cozy creative escape is one tap away.

items.description:
Traffic Flow is a clean, hypnotic idle game about one thing: moving people into
seats.

Passengers arrive as a glowing queue. They check in at the gate, walk the path,
step through the door and take a seat. Every seat that fills pays you. Fill the
whole vehicle and it departs, then the next one rolls in and the queue starts
again.

YOUR JOB IS THE BOTTLENECK

You never drive anything. You find whatever is slowing the line down and you fix
it. Three upgrade tracks, thirty levels each:

GATE. Faster check in, instant check in, and higher check in income.
TRANSIT. Faster walking, faster boarding, and income at the door.
SEATING. Faster seating, instant seating, and higher income per seat.

Push one track and the queue backs up somewhere else. Balancing all three is the
whole game.

FROM ONE SMALL PLANE TO A GLOBAL NETWORK

You start with a short hop out of Dublin and a plane with a few dozen seats.
Earn enough and you move up to a wide body jet where premium rows pay several
times what economy does, then to entirely new kinds of transit:

Planes. Long routes, big cabins, premium seating up front.
Buses. Short hops that turn over fast.
Trains. Multiple cars filling at the same time.
Ships. Huge twin aisle decks and the longest passenger queues in the game.

Each vehicle type is opened by a one time certificate from the research screen,
so every unlock is a real step change rather than another percentage.

ROUTES AND CITIES

The player hub is a route map for each vehicle type. Pick a city, see its seat
count and its income ceiling, and switch your run to it. Dublin, Singapore,
Cambridge, Brussels, Bilbao and more, each with a different mix of economy and
premium seats.

NUMBERS THAT ACTUALLY GO UP

Your first plane earns a few hundred a minute. Late game ships earn billions a
minute. The jump from hundreds to billions is the point, and you can watch every
step of it happen on one screen.

BUILT TO BE CALM

No timers pressuring you, no lives, no fail state. Pure neon on black, a readable
grid of seats, and a queue you can watch for as long as you like. Play with sound
off. Play one handed. Put it down mid boarding and pick it up later.

items.description:
Have you wanted to catch a fish, but you couldn't go to your favorite fishing spots? Have you been dissatisfied with casual fishing games? Play Fishing Clash – a free multiplayer fishing game chosen by millions of anglers and bring fishing and life together! 

Fishing Clash mixes the best features of multiplayer fishing games: the realism of simulator games, the competitiveness of sports games & the social aspect of fishing and hunting apps. With fishing spots from all over the world, it's the most realistic simulator amongst multiplayer fishing games.

How to quickly catch a fish in Fishing Clash?
• Launch the game.
• Tap the ""Cast"" button in the bottom-right corner.
• Tap the ""Strike"" button continuously to ensure the line tension indicator is in the center of the top bar.
• Enjoy the look of the fish on your fishing hook!

What's next?
• Relax, catch more fish, or win matches in exciting multiplayer duel mode.
• Take part in multiplayer challenges and championships.
• Upgrade your lure cards to level up and unlock new fishing spots.
• Conquer the fishing world!

Fishing around the world
In this multiplayer simulator, you can find a fishery almost everywhere: from the Florida Coast and the Kenai River to Lake Biwa, Galapagos, and Loch Ness. Here you can find a fishery almost everywhere in the world! Catch lots of fish like bass, carp, trout, and even some monster fish from the Deep Sea!

Collect and upgrade lure cards
Winning duels or getting top positions in championships will reward you with packs of lure cards. Collect them like in collectible card games and upgrade them to catch bigger fish! The bigger they are, the bigger the chance to win competitive multiplayer games and fishing world cup tournaments!

A simulator with real-time duels
Feel the thrill of multiplayer games and play a fishing duel against other anglers. You'll need not only skills but also your wits! Become a fishing master, get the biggest catch on your fishing hook and win every fishing battle.

Take part in live events
Every day you can hunt for amazing rewards like new rods, lure cards, and skill tokens in daily or weekly events. Pass the fishing trial, challenge angry sharks, become a catfish hunter or a traveler catching the biggest fish on a few different fishing spots!

Join or create a clan
Although Fishing Clash is a simulator at its heart, it enables ways to socialize like in free fishing apps. Meet fellow anglers, chat, exchange (or donate!) lure cards, and work together for great rewards in multiplayer Clan Wars.

The better the skills, the better your catch
All fishing spots have their skill tree. Use skill tokens to unlock new skills and get bonuses for fish of all rarities, and more!

Breathtaking fishing locations
Whether you prefer fly fishing, ice fishing, or trolling, you'll admire the look of all fishing spots. Every fishery in Fishing Clash features beautiful 3D vistas and hand-crafted fish you'll love to see on your fishing hook. It's a realistic simulator, after all.

Fresh, new content every week!
New fish, new fishery, new rods: in this realistic simulator, you can find new content every week, so there's no shortage of fish to catch! Bring fishing and life together!

Whether you're a seasoned angler or a multiplayer simulation games fan, Fishing Clash is a great casual time-killer. With dozens of fishing spots worldwide and hundreds of fish species, it offers an excellent experience for anybody looking for a realistic fishing simulator. DOWNLOAD NOW!

You're the underdog warrior, facing off against foes who've never heard of skipping leg day. But fear not! Every battle, win or lose, bulks up your "power" and "defense", visualized as your character's burgeoning muscles and towering stature.
Dive into levels where you embody fighters from across the globe - from a nimble boxer to a capoeira master, an MMA fighter to a streetwise brawler. Each defeat is just a step closer to becoming the ultimate boss yourself. With each upgrade, watch your character grow from a lightweight contender to a heavyweight champion.
But it's not all about brute strength; strategy is key. Choose your upgrades wisely to balance power and defense, ensuring your victory in the next round.
"Boss Fight" isn't just a game; it's a humorous journey of growth, resilience, and eventually, domination. Ready to punch, kick, and grow your way to victory? The bigger they are, the harder they fall - especially when you're the one growing!

items.description:
Lordrush is a medieval tower defense strategy game where you rebuild a ruined fortress and defend your realm from attacks.

Gather resources, raise defenses, upgrade towers, and recruit heroes as you prepare for each assault.

Set in a harsh medieval world of stone castles, armored heroes, war-torn battlefields, and rival lords, Lordrush blends fortress building, resource management, hero strategy, and tactical defense.


• Fight for Resources
Wood, stone, and iron are essential for expansion. Compete with exiles, rebels, and other forces for control of vital resources.

• Build Fortress Walls
Construct defensive walls to slow enemy advances and give your towers more time to strike.

• Upgrade Towers
Place and upgrade towers to expand your firepower, increase damage, and hold key defensive positions.

• Strengthen Your Fortress
As enemy attacks grow stronger, reinforce your walls, expand your towers, and turn your settlement into a powerful medieval stronghold.

• Defend Against Sieges
Enemies attack your fortress in waves. Adjust your defenses based on enemy routes and strength, and hold the line.

• Recruit Heroes
Recruit medieval heroes with different abilities. Deploy them to change the course of battle.

• Make Tactical Choices
Every building, upgrade, and hero deployment can affect the outcome. Plan carefully to survive the next siege.

• Manage Your People
Assign survivors as workers, hunters, or cooks to maintain resource production, food supplies, and daily fortress operations.

• Maintain Health and Order
Your people’s condition affects productivity. Keep food stocked, maintain stability, and help your fortress continue to grow.

• Issue Decrees
Set rules under pressure from scarce resources and outside threats. Maintain order and guide the growth of your stronghold.

• Join Alliances
Create or join alliances, share resources, coordinate defenses, and face powerful enemies together.

• Challenge Other Lords
Train heroes, build squads, and compete for points, rare rewards, and greater influence across the continent.

• Claim the Throne
Start from a single fortress, build your defenses, gather resources, expand your power, and become a lord who cannot be ignored.

versions.changelog:
[New Content]
1. New Feature [Oasis Island]: The sailors are ready and awaiting your command! Set sail in search of the legendary Oasis Island and build a new home.
2. New Feature [Realm Trial]: Take on challenges across six themed zones: the Radiant Spire, Molten Fort, Knowledge Nexus, Coliseum, Crystal Cave, and Forest of Life. Clear stages to earn generous rewards.
3. Comprehensive Skin System Upgrade:
(1) Added new skin categories for [Name Card], [Chat], [Rally], [Teleport], and [Profile], offering even more ways to express yourself.
(2) Added the [Throne Bastion] Castle Skin and [Dueler] March Skin.
(3) Added multiple new skins, including the [Empire Radiance] and [Guardian Army] Avatar Frames, the [Empire Radiance] and [Guardian Army] Nameplates, and the [Gem Shower] and [Cool] Emotes.
4. Added the [Lord Profile - Mood] feature: Set your Mood Status to let other Lords know how you feel and make interactions more fun.
5. Added the [Alliance Bomb] feature: Alliance officers can deploy bombs within their Alliance territory to clear Resource Nodes not being gathered by any Lord, as well as Beasts and Terrors, making Teleporting more convenient.
6. Added [Alliance Mobilization Mission Vouchers]: Use them to quickly refresh missions during Alliance Mobilization and select the mission type.
7. Added the [Empire Waystation]: Eligible Lords can unlock the [Empire Waystation] in the Top-up Center and purchase Empire Star Packs. Some packs also include bonus gifts to empower your journey across the Empire.
8. Added the [Empire Radiance Gift] event: Reward tiers are determined by each Lord's highest Top-up Points from a single payment. Once your highest Top-up Points from a single payment meet the specified requirement, you can claim rewards including the animated [Cool] Emote, permanent [Empire Radiance Name Card] Skin, permanent [Empire Radiance] Chat Skin, abundant resources, and Empire Stars.
Reminder: If your historical highest Top-up Points from a single payment already meet the corresponding requirement, you can claim the relevant rewards as soon as the event begins.
9. Added the [Empire Supreme Gift] event: Reward tiers are determined by each Lord's total Top-up Points accumulated in a single day. Accumulate the required Top-up Points on any day between 00:00:00 and 23:59:59 UTC to claim rewards including the permanent [Empire's Call] Teleport Skin.
Reminder: If your historical total Top-up Points on any single day already meet the corresponding requirement, you can claim the relevant rewards as soon as the event begins.

[Optimizations and Adjustments]
1. Pack Adjustment: "Fast Development Pack" has become unavailable after this update and can no longer be purchased when removed. A brand-new pack has been released at the same time, please check it out.
2. Several new reward tiers will be added to the "Top-up Gift" event. Complete them to obtain permanent skins: "Empire Radiance Avatar Frame" and "Empire Radiance Nameplate", along with many rare item rewards. Lords who have already reached the corresponding point targets before the update will be able to claim the newly added tier rewards directly after the update is complete.
3. Chat Emote Optimization: Tap a Chat Emote to view how to obtain it.
4. Auto Hunting Optimization: Added a customizable search range to improve hunting efficiency.
5. Bear Hunt Optimizations:
(1) Consolidated and improved Bear Hunt Battle Report mail for greater clarity;
(2) Added Auto-Register, allowing traps to be scheduled for the exact time their cooldown ends.
6. Art and Visual Optimizations:
(1) Improved the visuals of certain item icons and interfaces;
(2) Enhanced animations for beasts on the world map and pets in the Beast Cage;
(3) Improved display animations and visual clarity for certain Heroes (requires updating to the latest version).

Each level brings new obstacles, lane challenges, and bustling bus jams that will keep you engaged and entertained for hours.

Gameplay: Your mission in Bus Craze is to guide buses through congested streets and tricky intersections without causing accidents. Tap, move, and strategize each vehicle's path to clear jams and keep the city moving smoothly. With each level, you'll face new and more complex traffic puzzles that will require all your skills to solve!

Features:

Challenging Levels: Take on hundreds of traffic puzzles, from simple to complex, and keep the flow moving!
Puzzle Strategy: Exercise your mind with logic-based puzzles that will test your traffic-managing abilities.
Traffic Variety: Enjoy different traffic environments, from bustling city streets to busy highways, and discover unique jam scenarios.
Realistic Bus Traffic: Steer buses through realistic lanes, navigate tight intersections, and avoid collisions.
Smooth Controls: Easy-to-use controls make guiding buses and solving traffic puzzles a breeze.
Progressive Difficulty: Levels increase in complexity, providing new challenges as you master each jam.
No Time Limits: Play at your own pace, focusing on each puzzle with no rush.
Offline Play: Enjoy Bus Craze anytime, anywhere—no internet needed.


Why You'll Love Bus Craze:

Addictive Gameplay: Clearing traffic jams and solving puzzles is incredibly satisfying. Each level brings a new traffic scenario to solve.
Unique Puzzle Style: Unlike traditional puzzle games, Bus Craze combines traffic management with logic challenges, making it a fun way to pass the time.
Fun for All Ages: Simple controls and straightforward gameplay make Bus Craze enjoyable for kids, teens, and adults alike.
Interactive Graphics: Watch the city streets come to life with realistic traffic, vibrant buses, and bustling intersections.
Improve Focus & Strategy: As you work through traffic puzzles, you'll sharpen your attention, strategy, and critical thinking skills.
Unlimited Restarts: Got stuck? Restart any level as many times as needed and try a different approach without limits.

items.description:
Unravel the Threads. Complete the Pattern. Feel the Flow.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a relaxing yet deeply engaging sorting puzzle game where you unravel beautifully knitted artwork using colorful yarn bobbins. Instead of blasting or matching tiles, you carefully remove stitches in the correct order to clear each woven design piece by piece.

Every level feels like solving a handcrafted knitting puzzle.
Every move shapes the flow.
Every unravel delivers a satisfying visual payoff.

If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, color sorting challenges, flow puzzles, and calm strategy-based gameplay, Yarnation: Unravel Flow offers a smooth and rewarding experience that keeps your mind active while staying relaxing.

A UNIQUE YARN PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Bobbins move along a conveyor system and collect stitches of their own color.
Each bobbin has a limited capacity that decreases as it gathers matching yarn stitches.

When a bobbin’s capacity reaches zero, it disappears.
If capacity remains, it returns to the rack, ready to be reused later.

This simple yet clever system creates a satisfying puzzle loop where:

• Color selection matters
• Order matters
• Planning matters
• Capacity management matters

Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right sequence.

STRATEGY OVER SPEED

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is not about frantic tapping.
It’s about smart decisions and smooth sequencing.

As you advance through the levels:

• Patterns become more layered and detailed
• Colors overlap and intertwine
• Rack space becomes limited
• Managing your moves becomes more important

You’ll need to analyze the layout carefully, think a few steps ahead, and maintain a clean unravel flow without blocking yourself.

It’s a logic puzzle at heart — calm, thoughtful, and deeply satisfying.

COZY KNITTED AESTHETIC

Immerse yourself in a warm and visually charming yarn world featuring:

• Soft knitted textures
• Handcrafted pixel-style artwork
• Clean and colorful stitch patterns
• Smooth unravel animations
• Clear visual feedback

Watching a detailed knitted image slowly unravel into completion creates a uniquely relaxing puzzle experience.

PROGRESSIVE PUZZLE DEPTH

With hundreds of handcrafted levels, Yarnation: Unravel Flow introduces new challenges throughout progression:

• Fresh stitch arrangements
• New color combinations
• Deeper sequencing logic
• Smarter rack usage

The difficulty curve remains smooth and accessible while offering enough depth to keep puzzle lovers engaged.

SIMPLE CONTROLS, DEEP GAMEPLAY

The one-tap control system keeps the experience intuitive and easy to learn.

But beneath that simplicity lies a strategy puzzle built around:

• Color sorting
• Flow management
• Capacity control
• Smart sequencing

Easy to start.
Satisfying to master.

READY TO UNRAVEL?

Pull the right thread.
Plan your sequence.
Complete every knitted pattern with precision.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a fresh take on sorting puzzles — calm, strategic, visually satisfying, and beautifully woven.

items.description:
Build a trucking empire that spans the United States, one dispatch at a time.

Idle Truck Fleet is a transport tycoon where you grow a logistics company from a single van into a coast-to-coast operation. Open a live map of hubs and highways, hire drivers with real personality, and send your fleet rolling along routed paths you can actually watch.

WHAT YOU DO
Pick jobs from a rotating board where cargo type, payout, distance, and client tier all matter. Hire drivers whose traits change speed, pay, and how carefully they handle freight. Buy vans and semis, tap dispatch, and watch your trucks move across the country. Every clean delivery builds your reputation and your bank balance.

KEY FEATURES
- Fleet garage packed with dozens of real-world inspired trucks
- Driver roster with traits that shift speed, pay, and cargo care
- HQ Network: buy hubs to unlock new states and longer routes
- Company levels, reputation stars, and deep upgrade trees
- Research lab, achievements, and mega contracts from major clients
- World events that boost or disrupt the freight market
- Road incidents that put real decisions in your hands
- Diesel Cans to finish a haul early when you want the payout now
- AI Manager to dispatch all your trucks at once while you sleep

PROGRESSION
Start in Chicago with regional loads. Push into new states, unlock premium cargo, and chase a five-star reputation with clean, on-time deliveries. Invest in dispatch speed, negotiation, and marketing to grow a brand that drivers want to work for.

FLEET AI AND ABILITIES
Unlock Dispatch All to send your whole fleet out in a single tap. Stack research bonuses for reefers, hazmat, and fragile freight. React to hurricanes, fuel surges, and market booms that swing payouts on the job board.

IDLE EARNINGS
Your trucks keep rolling while you are away, up to your offline window. Come back to full delivery summaries and stacked earnings, not a thin idle trickle.

PERFECT IF YOU LOVE
Made for fans of idle tycoon games, truck and transport simulators, and business sim or management games. 
If you like money clicker progression and dispatcher style decisions, this one is your kind of grind: part logistics empire builder, part road trip across America. No racing, no parking, just smart dispatching and a delivery business that grows every time you check in.

Name your company. 
Hire your first driver. 
Roll your first truck. 
The highway is open and is yours!

items.short_description: Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled…
items.description:
Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled around scattered hearth-fires, listening for the whispers of the Old Ones, the ancient wicked gods who hungered for living warmth and dragged the souls of the weak into the underworld. Most clans flickered out before the first dawn. A few endured. And then, the spirits sent a Chief.

You are that Chief, the one whose will guides the people from above the firelight. Though you do not lift the spear yourself, every shaman you awaken bears your command, every villager labors by your decree, and every hearth-fire that burns is kindled because you have decided it should. From the high seat of an isolated tribe at the edge of the dark, you must reclaim wandering savages, summon legendary heroes to lead your warbands, build the first true settlement the Wilds have ever known, and forge a people strong enough to outlive the night.

Age of Spirits is a strategy game of awakening, ritual, and primal resolve. Will you raise tall stones around your hearth-fire and grow your tribe into a city of rites and crafts, or will you march your warbands deep into ancestral grounds to seize what only the bravest can win? The ancestors are watching. The Old Ones are stirring. The spark of all that is to come rests in your hands. Do you have the will to lead the first tribe into a new age?

GAME FEATURES

Awaken Savages, Bestow Wisdom: Bring untamed savages from the deep Wilds to your hearth-fire and awaken them as villagers. Assign your people to every post that matters, gathering, hunting, crafting, and tending the rites. Watching each pair of hands turn raw labor into the resources that grow your tribe.

Lead Expeditions, Claim the Spoils: 
Command your heroes on expeditions deep into ancestral grounds. Face perilous trials in turn-based combat, defeat champions of the dark, and bring home precious bounties and the rare materials no settlement can rise without.

Summon Legendary Heroes: 
Summon spirit-touched champions, such as fierce hunters, far-sighted wizards, and bone-clad guardians, to serve as the heroes of your tribe. Promote and equip them with ancestral weapons and ritual gear, then send your strongest to lead every march and stand at the front of every fight.

Build Your Tribe from a Single Fire:
Raise your settlement from a circle of stones into a thriving tribe. Kindle the central hearth, consecrate altars of wisdom and faith, sink quarries and woodyards, train new warriors, and upgrade every structure to unlock new units, rites, and strength.

Challenge Across the World Map:
March your armies across a vast living world. Lay claim to resource grounds, raid rival tribes, contest sacred lands, defeat field bosses, and write your name on the map in flame and stone.

Join Forces with Alliances:
Form alliances with players from across the world. Coordinate strategies, share resources, defend each other's lands, and wage large-scale battles together against rival forces.

SPECIAL NOTES
· This game includes random-item purchases.
· Network connection is required.
· Privacy Policy: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/
· Terms of Use: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/terms_of_use

items.name: Boss Breaker
items.short_description: Fire a volley. Watch it tear through the board. Do it again. Boss Breaker is an endless block breaker with no win condition and no finish line — just…
items.description:
Fire a volley. Watch it tear through the board. Do it again.

Boss Breaker is an endless block breaker with no win condition and no finish line — just a score, a board that keeps coming down, and the question of how long you can hold it back.

ONE MORE VOLLEY
Every round adds a ball. Every row that lands adds pressure. Aim down a channel and a single shot can rip the board apart; misjudge it and you have handed yourself a wall. There is no luck to blame — the same board would have broken for a better shot.

A COMBO LADDER THAT MEANS SOMETHING
Six tiers, from SWEET to LEGENDARY, tuned against real play rather than guesswork. LEGENDARY lands on roughly one volley in seventy-seven. When you see it, you earned it.

SIX WORLDS, SIX BOSSES
DUSK, SPACE, STORM, ABYSS, CORE, VOID. The progression is identical for every player, so a round number means the same thing to everyone — and a boss stands between you and each new world.

RECALL
Call your balls home early and bank the turn. You give up every hit they had left. Sometimes that is the right trade. Usually it isn't.

PLAYS ANYWHERE
- The game itself runs fully offline.
- No timers, no energy, no lives to wait for, nothing to buy.
- No account, no sign-up.
- One hand, portrait, any length of session.
- A short ad between some runs. That is the whole business model.

Hand-drawn pixel art, an original soundtrack of nothing but the sounds the game makes, and a high score that is yours alone.

versions.changelog: 3 NEW BOSSES AND 3 NEW POWERUPS! 2 silly geese have been added to the game and one holy cow. There are now POWERUPS. You can get an exploding ball, add 15 balls to your volley, or delete a block. You can also stack these powerups together to make some insane moments! Have fun.

Train Station 3: The Ultimate Train Tycoon Adventure!
Embark on a thrilling journey through time with Train Station 3, the ultimate train tycoon evolution game. Immerse yourself in the history and evolution of trains as you manage and expand your own railway empire, all while witnessing the power of realistic locomotives from different eras. This is not just a game; it’s a journey through the legacy of train transport, where you can fulfil your dream of becoming a true train tycoon!

Key Features:
- Progress through various historical eras, each with its own iconic trains
- Manage realistic, detailed train models from steam engines to high-speed trains
- Develop regions by transporting cargo, delivering goods, and expanding cities
- Unlock time-specific locomotives and discover the legacy of rail transportation
- Stunning visuals and immersive sound effects bring each locomotive to life
- Build and expand your railway empire across new regions and territories

Progress Through Historical Eras and Time-Specific Locomotives
Step into a timeline of railway history with each level. Train Station 3 is designed to let you progress through historical milestones, where each era unlocks a new set of trains that changed the course of transportation. Experience the thrill of managing iconic trains and seeing how transportation evolved across different centuries. From steam and diesel to electric locomotives, each time period offers its own unique challenges and rewards. 

Realistic Train Models and Stunning Visuals
Train Station 3 features some of the most realistic and detailed train models available in any mobile game. Every locomotive, from the oldest steam engine to the latest electric models, is crafted to perfection, with stunning visual detail that lets you experience the true power and beauty of these heavy machines. Watch in awe as they travel across your network, each train animated to show the strength and resilience of real locomotives.

Transport Cargo and Develop Regions
Take charge of transporting valuable cargo across regions, making key decisions about routes, schedules, and train models. As you progress through the game, you’ll unlock new regions to develop, each with its own resources, industries, and needs. Transport goods such as coal, oil, steel, and more to build up these regions and boost your railway’s reputation. The more efficiently you deliver cargo, the faster you’ll unlock rewards and expand your network. With each successful delivery, you’ll earn valuable resources to further enhance your empire.

Witness the Majesty of Heavy Train Machines
Get up close to the action as trains thunder along your tracks, bringing life to your railway empire. Train Station 3 gives you the unique opportunity to witness these heavy machines in action as they haul cargo across vast landscapes. Enjoy the thrill of watching powerful locomotives chugging along, carrying precious resources through cities and countryside alike. With immersive sound effects and realistic animations, you’ll feel as though you’re right there on the platform, experiencing the strength and resilience of these mighty machines.

Step into the fascinating world of train evolution with Train Station 3, where every train you unlock and every region you develop brings you closer to becoming the ultimate railway tycoon. Download Train Station 3 now and start building your railway legacy!

The last bastion of humanity has fallen. As the Commander of a final group of survivors, you face a grim new world in the aftermath of doomsday. You hid in an abandoned underground shelter. Build your underground stronghold, but remember: survival demands more than walls—it requires expansion, exploration, and relentless combat.​

【BUILD YOUR SURVIVAL SHELTER】
Your underground fortress is the heart of your resistance. Build and customize every room—from Power Generators and Research Labs to Control Centers. Upgrade your facilities to unlock advanced weapons. Design your layout with tactical strategy, because this isn't just a home, it's a war base that fuels your fight to reclaim the world.

【EXPLORE & COLLECT UNDERGROUND】
The real adventure lies in the darkness. Send elite squads into unexplored tunnels and the desolate wastelands shown on your map. Scavenge for vital resources, uncover lost technology, and undertake critical missions to rescue other survivors and search for a cure​ under the zombie horde. Every expedition is a high-stakes mission: stay vigilant—zombies lurk everywhere, and danger strikes without warning.

【FIGHT ZOMBIES】
Combat is brutal and constant. Face off against zombie swarms, terrifying mutant bosses, and other enemy threats lurking in the shadows. Assemble a team of unique heroes, master their powerful abilities, and devise tactical formations to crush your enemies in intense battle. Engage in clashes where you must shoot, fight with guns, and survive enemy fire.

【BASE DEFENSE & TOWER TACTICS】
Your shelter is a prize coveted by all. Defend it from waves of zombies and raids from rival commanders! Construct defensive fortifications, lay cunning traps, and strategically place guard towers to create an impenetrable fortress. Use your radar to detect incoming enemy​ hordes and plan your strategy.

【FORM ALLIANCES FOR DOMINANCE​】
Forge powerful alliances with other players to conquer the wasteland together. Coordinate attacks, share resources, and participate in large-scale alliance wars to dominate the ruined cityscapes. Victory in this endless war belongs to those who unite.

Last Shelter: War Z offers a rich, strategic survival experience with a focus on exploration, combat, and cooperation. The apocalypse was the end of the world, but this is the start of yours. Will you lead humanity to rebirth? Download now and begin your underground odyssey!

versions.changelog:
26.0904.001 Version Update Announcement
Dear Commander:
The details of Version 26.0904.001 update are as follows:

[New Content]
1. Added the Milestone of Glory mode. After the victor of the War of Eden is decided, a Milestone of Glory symbolizing supreme honor will stand in the world. Commanders across the server can jointly participate in monument construction and the Grand Celebration to win generous server-wide rewards.
2. Added the world chest exploration mode. Commanders can search for and open mysterious chests scattered across the map to obtain surprise supplies.
3. Added the gift redemption code feature. Commanders can enter redemption codes in the Settings UI to conveniently redeem rich supplies and item rewards.

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Optimized the Moments feature and added cross-server support. Commanders can view posts across servers and participate in interactions.
2. Optimized the participation experience for Champion Duel and added an auto-registration feature.
3. Optimized alliance-related experiences, refilled detailed display for Alliance Activity chests rewards, and adjusted demotion rules for the Alliance Duel League as well as the unlocking pace for Alliance BOSS level caps.
4. Optimized 5v5 combat performance and improved the casting smoothness and hit feedback for some hero skills.
5. Optimized UI interaction and visual layout, fully iterating information displays for the Arena, Doomsday Bounty, personal homepage, and certain inner city building UIs.
6. Optimized world rendering quality to improve scene detail texture and frame smoothness when exploring the world map.

[Issues Repair]
1. Fixed an issue where some commanders might not be able to proceed normally with chapter quests after promoting a hero.
2. Fixed an issue where field exploration or stage battles occasionally failed to start normally under certain circumstances.
3. Fixed a display issue where the translate button overlapped with the message read marker in the chat UI.
4. Fixed an issue where the UI display values of certain World BOSS faction buffs were inconsistent with their actual effective values.
5. Fixed an issue with abnormal UI text display in the Alliance Duel League.
6. Fixed an issue where commanders' base nameplate colors were displayed abnormally under certain circumstances.
7. Fixed an issue where counter-strike DMG attributes were calculated abnormally under specific circumstances in rally battles.
8. Fixed an issue where crashes or lag occasionally occurred on some devices when a large number of marches appeared in world view or when quickly sliding the map.
9. Repaired some underlying stability issues when viewing red packet logs and sending alliance push notifications.

Thank you, commanders, for your continued support, and enjoy the game!

Last Shelter: War Z Team

■ If you like cooperative play, visit the city in the Crater. There you'll meet loyal companions and find out what you're worth in PvP. Join a clan, play with other players, feel the unity of a real pack! 

■ Survivor (if you're reading this, it means I can still call you that), you have access to an arsenal of cold weapons and firearms that even a seasoned hardcore player would envy: baseball bats, shotguns, rifles, a good old assault rifle, mortars, and explosives. The list is endless, and it's better for you to see it with your own eyes.

■ Forests, Police Station, Spooky Farm, Port, and Bunkers packed with zombies, raiders, and other random characters. Always be ready to use force or flee. Anything goes, when it comes to survival!

Now you are a survivor. No matter who you are, where you come from, and what you used to be before. Welcome to the cruel new world...

items.description:
Game is Hard is not your typical puzzle app. This is a pure brain puzzle experience designed for players who love being challenged. With its clever, minimalist style and unexpected interactions, it blends elements of brain games, logic, and device-based exploration into a collection of brutally tricky levels.

Every puzzle breaks the rules — no flashy animations, no rewards for guessing. Just you, your mind, and a seemingly simple task that might hide a brilliant, almost impossible solution. Whether you’re into strategy, trivia games, or iq test challenges, Game is Hard invites you to test your patience, perception, and persistence.

This is not about fast reflexes. It’s about slow, methodical progress. Some levels require silence. Others need movement. Many seem unsolvable — until they’re not. It’s a place for deep thinking and bold experimentation. Hints are available when needed, but progress is always earned.

If you've enjoyed titles like brain test games, logic puzzles, IQ tests, moron test or brain teaser games, and if you love dissecting a good tricky quest, this game is for you.  It rewards those who think differently — the curious, the clever, the quietly stubborn.

With full support for offline games, you can play wherever and whenever you want — perfect for no wifi games, no internet games, or long travel sessions. Whether you're on airplane mode or deep underground, all puzzles remain playable.

And yes — it’s hard. In fact, some say it's difficult, others call it impossible. But every puzzle is built with purpose and can be solved with logic. If you're a fan of brain training, mind games, or just enjoy testing your limits, you'll find yourself right at home.

Each level acts like a black mystery, a box full of secrets waiting to be unraveled. You'll experiment with sound, light, rotation, and pressure — even waiting. This box won’t open easily. But when it does, the satisfaction is unmatched.

Designed for fans of both classic and modern puzzle games, Game is Hard avoids the noise of the typical mobile fun games and focuses instead on clarity, challenge, and meaningful interaction. There’s no time pressure. No ads. No noise. Just deep puzzles that respect your intelligence.

Whether you see yourself as a genius, an impulse problem-solver, or simply someone who enjoys a good brainly test, this game invites you to try. And try again. And maybe… finally, succeed.

Features:
 • Handcrafted brain puzzle levels with clever, logical solutions
 • Hints are available — but never obvious
 • Works fully offline — great for no wifi games and free play
 • Minimalist, flat design with zero distractions
 • Touch, motion, and sound-based mechanics
 • Built for players who enjoy hard, clever, and unusual challenges
 • No scores or timers— just pure gameplay
 
Can you solve the black box? Or will it remain closed forever?

Forget boring party games. Picoboom is the vibe check your group needs: chaotic, hilarious, and completely unhinged. And now it's home to the game your group won't stop playing: hunt down the Imposter before they fool the whole room.

Get ready to
- Bluff, accuse, and roast your friends like never before

items.description:
Want to improve your math skills without having to memorize a hundred tricks? Mental Math Cards is designed to help people of all ages and skill levels improve their arithmetic abilities through easy to remember (and use) tips, practice question sets, and an addictive game. Unlike many other math apps, advanced problems are also supported to keep things challenging as your skills improve.

Mental Math Cards is fully integrated with Game Center - providing both Leaderboards and Achievements. The Game Center features allow you to test your skills against the rest of the world and to share your scores and accomplishments with friends. 

Mental Math Cards provides step by step instructions on how to approach solving all of the problems it shows - for all operations and difficulty levels. Each difficulty level for each operation type is carefully thought out to build on the skills mastered in previous levels. For instance, hard multiplication problems are shown to be solvable by breaking problems down into medium and easy level problems. 

Students: Prepare for the math sections of the PSAT, SAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT, and MCAT, as well as for regular school tests. Many tests don't allow for calculators, and greater comfort with arithmetic will still improve your scores even if calculators are allowed. 

Professionals: Impress colleagues, family, and friends with lightning fast and accurate mental math skills. Impress interviewers during job interviews that have quantitative component by solving problems without needing a pencil and paper. 

Mental Math Cards supports 1 by 1, 2 by 1, 2 by 2, and 3 by 3 digit problems. Given that flexibility, Mental Math Cards is as appropriate for use by beginning students as it is for college graduates looking to sharpen their skills for quantitative interviews and to impress friends & colleagues.

Mental Math Cards supports all four of the major arithmetic operations - as well as a mixed operations mode that randomly shows all types of problems. 

- Addition
- Subtraction
- Multiplication
- Division

Feel free to contact me with any feedback and feature suggestions.

So you think you understand this thing you’re holding? Think again. Stop tapping. Stop swiping. In fact, stop touching the screen at all. To crack Blackbox’s puzzles you’ll need to find solitude and stillness, climb mountains, call on friends, get in tune with the cosmos, and think outside the box.

Minimalistic visual clues make for incredibly satisfying “Aha!” moments, while sonic interfaces provide an extra level of guidance and nuance that makes Blackbox accessible with or without vision. Thoughtful haptic feedback, Easter eggs on Easter eggs, and solutions that can’t be found beneath the glass of your screen redefine what a puzzle can be. You’ll never see your device the same way again.

Think you’re clever? Prove it.

(Blackbox is a living game under active development by Ryan McLeod. When not eating burritos or drinking coffee, he’s busy designing and developing new Blackbox challenges.)

STOP 2 is the pen-and-paper trivia word game you know and love ... and now it's better than ever!

STOP, Tutti Frutti, Bus STOP or Basta - whatever you may call it, the goal of this words game is still the same - to answer the word categories with the correct terms, beat competitors, and have lots of fun. Can you guess the answer? How smart are you?

One letter! Five-word categories! 60 seconds! Infinite chances to become a trivia quiz legend of challenge games... or at least laugh, have fun and play with your friends. It's fresher, funnier, and more hectic than ever—and yet, no pen or paper required.

STOP 2 has updated the beloved quiz word game STOP for the modern concept of online games with friends. A new, customized experience where you can collect timers and select skins. There are themed, unique events, advanced multiplayer games and match-making, and new word game modes to play this challenging quiz.

From the studio that brought you the smash-hit crossword categories game CodyCross, Word Lanes, Everyday Puzzle: Fun Brain Games, LunaCross: Crossword Riddles, and the award-winning original game STOP - Guess the answer, an App Store Editor's Choice in 18 countries!

UNIQUE AND CLASSIC FEATURES

- An update of the pen-and-paper categories word trivia game!

- One on one...don’t forget to invite others and enjoy this online game with friends, also known as tutti frutti

- Done answering? Stop the timer and end your rival’s answer round early. Word with friends is even better now. A trivia word game where you guess correctly or lose

- 200+ fun and unique categories (and counting)! Can you answer more them 20 questions and categories in a row?

- Play anywhere: on the couch, on the go, on your lunch break ... it's all good! The perfect, fun games for when you're bored

- Friends busy? Don't let the game STOP. Let the multiplayer matchmaking feature find you a brand new nemesis to add to your fight list

- Learn new words, answer questions, meet new people, and become a STOP champion and master.

NEW FEATURES

How many trivia games do you know of that are this fun? Are you ready to enjoy the new features of this riddle challenge and multiplayer game?

- Hone your skills against tricky AI opponents in the new arcade gameplay mode of this word categories game!

- Create a CUSTOM look all your own with new themed skins. Play with friends and see who has the best skin.

- Collect new themed timers in this online game with friends!

- New seasonal, themed, and timed events offer fresh challenges. Guess the answer and show off your word skills!

- Player rankings to display your word puzzle prowess and trivia crack skills to the world!

STOP 2 is a word, trivia, and general knowledge competitive and category game. Can you guess the answers? The prizes are waiting for you!

NON-STOP WORD GAME

Are you a competitive player? Do you like word games more than others? You can take advantage of available boosts - unlimited life power-up and no ads ever! You can have no ads game. Two sports. One run. The regular season is just the start.

All-Timers is a draft-and-survive sports game. Spin to draw a franchise and a decade, pick one player, and build an all-time roster across seven rounds. Then run your season and see how far the lineup you built can go.

Win every game and you finish undefeated. The season doesn't end there. Earn a playoff berth and the gauntlet opens: keep winning to reach a flawless 20-0 in football or an undefeated title run in basketball. The deeper you go, the higher your Season Score.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Draft a roster one spin at a time. Each spin deals you a franchise and an era. You pick the player.
- Two sports in one app, one account. Build a football roster, a basketball roster, or both.
- Run the regular season, then chase the playoff gauntlet the rest of the genre stops short of.
- Your Draft Average (.000 to 1.000) scores how close you came to the perfect draft, so a strong run rewards your decisions, not just your luck.

MODES
- Free Play: draft, run a full season, chase the gauntlet, beat your best.
- Daily Challenge: everyone drafts from the same deal. One shot, ranked on the leaderboard.
- Play With Friends: send a challenge, compare rosters head to head, settle who drafts better.

WHY ALL-TIMERS
- Two sports, not one. Move between football and basketball without a second app.
- A real finish line. The playoff run to a perfect record is the chase no other draft game gives you.
- Skill, measured. Draft Average and server-verified scores reward smart picks and keep the leaderboard honest.
- Built to share. Every run makes a card worth posting.

No account needed to play. Sign in to save your seasons, climb the leaderboard, and challenge friends.

All-Timers is an independent game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or licensed by any professional sports league, team, or organization. Player references use names and statistics only.

items.description:
Someone always gets exposed. Someone always loses. The only question is who will be holding the phone when the bomb goes off.

Boomit Party combines pass-the-phone gameplay, Most Likely questions, party challenges, and a ticking bomb mechanic to create a different experience every round —for any group, anywhere, any night. No cards. No setup. One phone. Let's go.

GAME MODES
Pass It On: The phone moves around the group. Read the prompt, answer fast, and keep passing. Whoever holds it when the bomb explodes loses the round. Simple. Tense. Impossible to put down.
Be Exposed: Everyone votes anonymously on a question. The person with the most votes gets revealed. Find out what your friends really think — whether you're ready for it or not.
Team Rush: Split into teams and race through challenges, categories, and rapid-fire rounds. The bomb is still ticking. Work fast or lose together.

MOST LIKELY QUESTIONS
Who is most likely to ghost someone and pretend nothing happened? Cry at a commercial? Start a rumor by accident?
Most Likely is one of Boomit's most-played formats. The group votes, the result gets revealed, and someone always has something to say about it.

WHAT MAKES EVERY ROUND DIFFERENT
4,000+ prompts and challenges — lighthearted, funny, bold, unexpected, and everything in between.
Themes for every vibe — icebreakers, casual hangouts, chaotic party nights, travel sessions, and more.
Fully customizable — set the timer, player count, and theme so the game fits your group, not the other way around.
Built for 6+ players — house parties, college nights, road trips, birthday parties, game nights, and any moment someone asks "what should we do?"

THE BOMB CHANGES EVERYTHING
Most party games let you think. Boomit doesn't. The ticking bomb keeps every round moving — no long debates, no slow turns, no dead moments. Just pressure, laughs, and someone holding the phone at the wrong time.
Whether you're breaking the ice with new people or playing with your closest friends, the bomb makes sure everyone stays in the game from the first round to the last.

PERFECT FOR
A party game for friends at a house party
A no-card game for game night
A Most Likely questions app for groups
An icebreaker game for new people
A travel-friendly group game for road trips and vacations
A fun party game for college students, roommates, and friend groups
A quick party game for 6 or more players

HOW TO PLAY
Choose a game mode. Set your timer and player count. Read the prompt out loud. Answer, vote, guess, or pass the phone. Whoever holds it when the bomb goes off loses the round.
Every round plays differently. Every night becomes a story.

Download Boomit Party and find out who gets exposed first.

In each round, players are given a secret word, except one: the Impostor, who must fake their way through the conversation and figure out the word without getting exposed. The Civilians must subtly confirm each other’s knowledge of the word while watching closely for anyone acting suspicious.

But there’s another wildcard in the mix: Mr. White. This player doesn’t receive any word at all. No clue, no help, only improvisation and bluffing. If Mr. White survives the round or correctly guesses the word, they win.

The gameplay is simple to learn but full of strategy. Ask questions, answer carefully, and pay attention to tone, hesitation, and clever deception. After every round of discussion, players vote. items.description:
WorldGuessr is the ultimate geography guessing game, the #1 alternative to GeoGuessr. Get dropped into Street View anywhere on Earth, read your surroundings, and guess where in the world you are. The closer your guess, the higher you score!
Whether you're a GeoGuessr veteran or brand new to geography games, WorldGuessr turns your knowledge of the world into addictive, competitive fun, with no paywall, no play limits, and no catch.

EXPLORE THE ENTIRE WORLD
Spawn into a random Street View location from any corner of the globe. Study the road signs, landscapes, architecture, language, and vegetation to pinpoint where you are and drop your pin.

HOW SCORING WORKS

Every round is scored out of 5,000 points. Nail the exact spot and you bank a perfect 5K. The farther your pin lands from the true location, the fewer points you earn, so precision pays off. Across a five-round game that means a perfect run is 25,000 points. Watch your score climb, beat your personal best, and measure yourself against players around the world. Using hints halve your score, and playing country or continent guesser modes cap your max score to 1K points. 

HOW TO PLAY

Look around an immersive 360 degree Street View
Read the clues: signs, cars, nature, buildings
Drop your guess on the world map
Score points based on how close you were, up to 5,000 per round
Beat your high score and climb the ranks

PERFECT FOR BEGINNERS: COUNTRY AND CONTINENT MODES
New to geography games? Start here. In Country Guesser you get dropped into a random location and simply pick which country you think it is, no pinpoint pin required. Continent Guesser is even more forgiving: just choose the right continent. These modes are way easier than full map guessing, so they're the perfect way to learn the clues, build confidence, and train your eye before jumping into Street View challenges.

GAME MODES FOR EVERYONE
Singleplayer: the classic world map, single countries, or thousands of community-made maps
Daily Challenge: fresh locations every day; chase the top score
Country and Continent Guesser: pure geography, no Street View needed, ideal for beginners
Ranked Duels: go 1v1, earn ELO, and climb the global leaderboard
Unranked Duels: fast, low-pressure head-to-head matches
Private Party Games: make a room and play custom games with up to 200 players

MULTIPLAYER THAT ACTUALLY MATTERS
Challenge players worldwide in real-time duels. Earn ELO, rank up, fire off emotes, add friends, and settle the score in a rematch. Competitive geoguessing, rebuilt for mobile.

OVER 10,000 CUSTOM MAPS
This is where WorldGuessr really opens up. Anyone can create a map, which means there are more than 10,000 community-made maps to explore. Want to test yourself only on your home country, your home city, a favorite region, or a wildly specific theme? There's a map for it, and if there isn't, you can build your own in minutes and share it. From the full world to a single neighborhood, there's always a new place to discover.

100% FREE, NO PAYWALL
No subscription to play. No daily limits hiding the good stuff. WorldGuessr is the complete geography-guessing experience, free, in your pocket.

JOIN MILLIONS OF PLAYERS
WorldGuessr is played by millions of geography and travel lovers around the world. Jump in and see how your world knowledge stacks up against the planet.
If you love geography, map quizzes, flags, travel, or just exploring the world from Street View, WorldGuessr is your new obsession.

Download WorldGuessr free and start exploring!

items.description:
Official daily Worldle game from Teuteuf Games - guess the country by its shape and test your geography knowledge with 7 bonus rounds.

Each day you’re presented with a new country or territory shape and have to guess its name in 6 tries. With each guess, you will receive a hint - the direction (North, East, South, or West), the distance, and the proximity from your guess to the target location.

After the country/territory is revealed, you can choose which bonus rounds to play – Neighbours (guess the neighbouring countries), Capital (guess the capital), Flag (guess the flag), Spoken languages (guess the 2 most spoken languages and learn how to say “My name is” is each of them), Population & Currency (guess the population and currency in a multiple choice quiz), Populous cities (put the 4 most populous cities in the correct order), Area (guess the size of the country).

Please, note: there are several copycat apps of this game but this is the official Worldle from Teuteuf Games (teuteuf.fr).

Playing Zen Word 10 minutes a day brings you incredible challenging and relaxing experiences.
 
Zen word is a challenging word game & brain game that helps to train your brain and sharpen your mind. Zen Word is much more challenging than most other word puzzle games. Unlike crossword puzzles games or word cross games or word scramble games, all words in Zen Word are uncrossed, without any logical connection that can give you hints to help you solve the puzzles.  In Zen Word, you need to search and connect the right letters to find 20 hidden words on average in each level to test your vocabulary. The length of the words is the only clue that will help you find all the words and solve the puzzles. Therefore, Zen Word has very high requirements for your vocabulary and spelling skills. All word puzzles in Zen Word are carefully designed and will definitely give you a completely different challenging experience. 

Also, Zen Word is very different from word-search games. In word search games, your objective is to find and mark all the words hidden inside the letters box. The arrangement of these words in word-search games has clear rules, even if you don't know the spelling of the words, you can still search and find all the hidden words to solve the puzzles. As you find more words, the difficulty of word search games gets easier. However in Zen Word, as you find more words, the difficulty of the game will increase sharply. The rest of the words are extremely hard for you to remember and to spell. In the process of recalling words, you can make your brain sharper. Zen word is a word game for adults to train their brains. 
 
In addition to bringing you a super challenging experience, Zen Word can also bring you the best relaxing and calm experience.In some crossword puzzles or some word search games or word finder games, you must find all words in limited time, giving you a lot of pressure. Also, in word scramble games, you need to score more points than your friends to win and can not enjoy the word puzzle solving process. In Zen Word, there is no countdown, no competition or any other designs that make you anxious or interrupt your puzzle solving experience. You can fully immerse yourself in word puzzles, accompanied by beautiful and peaceful nature backgrounds and peaceful music. All the backgrounds and music are carefully selected in the style of zen. items.description:
Crossword Master is a turn-based word game where you and your opponent work together to complete a crossword puzzle while competing for the highest score. Dive into this highly addictive experience and enjoy endless fun! Solve crosswords, outsmart your opponents, and become a word master!

Discover a fresh take on daily crossword puzzles: draw letters from the deck, and craft words according to the clues. Inspired by Scandinavian-style crosswords, Crossword Master features clues within the cells to enhance gameplay convenience. Some of the clues are pictures, which adds an extra layer of challenge and fun!

Crossword Master strikes the perfect balance between entertainment and a useful brain exercise. Each crossword puzzle is carefully designed to train your language skills, spelling, logic, and general knowledge. Explore thousands of words, enrich your vocabulary, and master the art of crossword games!

How to play:

- Your goal in this turn-based game is to craft words on the crossword board according to the clues and outscore your opponent.
- Use blue cells with clues to guess words. Find the right fit for each letter from a set of five and place them one by one from the deck to start forming words.
- Try to place all the letters from the deck in each turn to maximize your score. Every correct letter earns one point, with additional points awarded for completing words. Aim to construct longer words and multiple words in a single move for the highest scores.
- Think strategically. Sometimes, holding back a crucial letter for a future move can help create a longer word and boost your score potential.

What you get:

• Engaging crossword game with smooth graphics and a modern look
• Plenty of unique crossword puzzles for adults packed with countless words to unravel, keeping you hooked for hours!
• Hints available to assist when you're stuck and need a clue
• Auto-save ensures you can resume any unfinished crossword anytime without losing your progress
• No time limit. Enjoy this crossword game at your own pace.

Solve crossword puzzles anywhere, anytime, stretch your cognitive limits, and become a master of words!

items.description:
Are you a word games master? Whether you are a fan of classic crossword puzzles or are just hopping on viral new word game trends, Wordle! will get you thinking. Take on daily brain teasers and train your mind with our fun word games.  

With several unique game modes, Wordle! will Challenge your mind and spelling skills. Want a fun and viral challenge? Try Daily Puzzle mode, where you’ll have 6 guesses to solve the word of the day. Each time you get a letter correct, the tile will turn yellow if it is in the word or green if it is in the right spot. Can you solve it with one guess? Once you’ve figured it out, share your score with friends. It's just like the viral word game, but on your phone! 

Can’t get enough Wordle!? Play Unlimited Wordle! in Classic mode, and play as long as you want. No need to wait a whole day for the next puzzle. Getting stuck? Not to worry! Use a hint to get out of a sticky situation and unlock the solution!

Or take on a timed challenge in Word Fever mode, where you will test your speed and spelling skills. Spell the word before the timer runs out, each time you find the word, the timer will reset and you will have to think fast and solve the next word. How far can you go?

Want to test your mind for the duration? In Secret Word mode you will have 3 chances to guess each word with the letters and clue provided. Push your word association skills to the limit, and guess each word before moving on to the next. Guess wisely, 3 incorrect guesses and you will have to start over!  

Expand your adult mind and make your brain stronger with our free word games! It is like taking your brain to the gym!

Wordle! Together. Choose a word and challenge your friends to see if they can guess it in six tries or less. Take turns solving each other’s words and earn points for solving the least amount of guesses. Enter a random match or challenge your friends to the ultimate viral battle of wits! It’s a fun and all new way to Wordle!  

Game Features 
 
1. Fun Word Puzzles
Play the viral word game, or try one of our fun and creative game modes for a unique challenge like you’ve never seen before 

2. Unlimited Wordle! 
Solve as many Wordle! puzzles as you’d like In Classic mode. No need to wait a whole day for the next puzzle! 

3. Share Your Results
Try Daily Puzzle mode, where you can solve the Wordle! of the day, then share your results and compare stats with friends

4. Special Boosters 
Having trouble? Unlock special boosters like the Dart, which will remove letters or Hint to reveal a correct letter, or use a Skip to pass a level entirely or try again if you lose. 

5. Play at Your Own Pace:
Whether you enjoy the pressure of a timed challenge, or want to try to go the duration in Secret Word mode. Wordle! Has several games to play at your desired pace

6. Flex Your Brain Muscles
Ready for a tougher challenge? Test your skills in more challenging levels with longer words!  Will you be the Wordle! Champion?

Designed for steady improvement without frustration
Whether you are a beginner or a word expert, the game adapts to your pace.

Train Your Brain Naturally
Improve vocabulary and spelling
Strengthen memory and pattern recognition
Enhance focus through structured puzzles
This is a brain game that feels relaxing, not stressful.

Built for Daily Play
Offline gameplay anytime

Poople is a daily word game where you get to POOP!
The objective of the game is to turn a starting word into the word “poop” by changing one letter at a time. The catch, of course, is that each word on the chain must be a valid English word. 

The game is scored on the length of your path—the quicker you get to poop, the better. Once you reach poop, you will see a history of your scores, and you can copy your results for the day in an emoji grid format. The starting word resets daily and is the same for every player, so challenge your friends to beat your score!

items.description:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.

The rules of Easy Words are quite simple:

- The game is played on a 13x13 board.
- You and your opponent receive 7 tiles with letters on them from a tile bag. You have to connect letters in different ways and place the tiles on the board to make a word.
- Words can be formed either horizontally or vertically.
- The player who starts the word game should place a word containing at least two letters onto the board with at least one tile placed in the central square.
- There are 44 bonus cells on the board. They allow you to multiply the points you receive either for a letter or the whole word if a tile with a letter is placed on one of them.
- The game is over when either player uses the last tile, or both of them skip two moves in a row, or if either player has no possible moves left.
- The user with the higher score at the end of the game wins.

- Hints. If you are stuck solving word puzzles, simply use a hint.
- Swap. If you have run out of ideas and don’t know what you can create with the tiles you have, just swap the tiles in your deck.

items.description:
NO NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED. 

Build a brain-boosting daily habit. Solve new word, logic and visual puzzles every day and explore collections inspired by favorite Netflix worlds.

Ready for a new morning routine? Make this your home base for daily puzzles and find something fresh to play every day, from the brain-teasing word game Bonza to the classic logic challenge Sudoku. Solve without distractions, online or offline, with no in-game ads to interrupt.

Keep your mind sharp with special puzzle collections that weave in the magic of Netflix series and films, from "KPop Demon Hunters" to "Squid Game" and "Black Mirror." Find new puzzles every day in the app or at Tudum.com, and get started on a legendary solving streak.

DAILY PUZZLES FOR WORD WIZARDS
*** Word puzzles are only available in English for now. ***

• Combo •
Link together a chain of phrases, using words and symbols to connect overlapping expressions.

• Bonza •
Take a hint from the theme and join together pieces of words (vertically or horizontally) until all the segments connect — like a crossword combined with a jigsaw puzzle.

• Crossover •
Switch the position of letters and icons in a mini crossword grid, using clues, until you get the right word in every row and column.

• Waywords •
Go on a word search journey. Form a path to the end of each puzzle by finding words that fit the theme — and steer clear of decoys!

DAILY PUZZLES FOR LOGIC LOVERS

• Currents •
Find the flow in this path-tracing puzzle. Create a single, unbroken stream to connect all the numbers.

• Sudoku •
Use your powers of deduction to fill a grid with the numbers 1 through 9 in this classic logic game. Each number can only appear once in every row, column and 3x3 block.

• Starstruck •
Figure out the perfect spacing of stars on a grid so that there's only one star in each row, column and colored region, with no star neighboring another. 

DAILY PUZZLES FOR VISUAL THINKERS

• Neon •
Light up the board! Link each pair of brightly colored symbols without getting your wires crossed.

• Snippets • 
Follow the numbers to unfold colored paper into rectangular spaces and watch a hidden figure come to life.

• Jigsaw •
Fit puzzle pieces together to complete an image in this perfectly portable twist on the classic pastime.

- Created by Next Games, a Netflix Game Studio.
